The Sr. AI Applied Scientist (Fraud Prevention): drives experimental research and novel algorithm development to detect and predict emerging fraud trends. The candidate has an innovative approach with passion for fraud detection and prevention along with creativity in data visualization. The scientist will work with different partners across Adobe to develop outstanding fraud detection capabilities. 

What you'll Do 

Develop LLM Agentic Workflow and ML models to predict and detect fraud from historical and emerging trends across various platforms and products.

Automate manual workflows with AI to build efficiencies and scale up fraud reviews, investigations, and operational workflows. 

Translate investigations and intel into root cause analysis to find opportunities for scale. 

Lead experimental research to invent novel ML algorithms and LLM-based agentic workflows for fraud detection, pushing the state-of-the-art in the field.

Design and validate new automation paradigms using state-of-the-art AI, driving the transfer of these research innovations into scalable operational processes.

Conduct rigorous data analysis and experimentation to identify novel patterns, contributing to the scientific community through publications and patents.

 

 

What you need to succeed 
 

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related quantitative field is preferred. A Master's degree with strong evidence of research activity (e.g., scientific publications in conferences like NeurIPS, ICML, AAAI, CVPR, IJCAI, ACL etc, patents, or equivalent applied research in industry) is also acceptable.

6+ years of proven experience in data science, machine learning, with a focus on fraud detection or risk management in subscription-based businesses or financial services. 

Expertise in AI and ML techniques, including LLM API, Agentic Framework, supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, and ensemble methods. 

Proficiency in programming languages such as SQL, Python or R. 
Strong understanding of big data technologies and distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) for handling large-scale datasets. 

Deep research experience in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic Workflows, with a proven track record of translating theoretical research into production-grade systems.

Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and drive alignment on fraud detection strategies. 

Proven track record of leading complex AI/ML projects from conception to production deployment, delivering tangible business value. 

Experience with fraud detection tools and platforms (e.g., fraud detection APIs, fraud management systems) is highly recommended.

The success of generative AI guardrails is not determined solely by model architecture; it is defined by the quality of the concepts we protect, the robustness of our detection science, and the realism of our evaluation methodology. 

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is expanding its IP guardrail systems for building safe and compliant image, video, and audio generative models. A central challenge is long-tail IP coverage: foundation models cannot internalize every protected concept. Advancing our guardrails therefore requires principled approaches to multimodal knowledge integration, detection modeling, and real-world evaluation science. 

We are seeking an Applied Scientist to drive the scientific development of IP concept modeling, detection strategies, and evaluation frameworks that determine the robustness ceiling of our guardrail systems. This is a research-oriented role focused on advancing multimodal detection and evaluation methodologies at production scale. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Multimodal Concept Modeling & Knowledge Integration 

Develop principled methods for representing and organizing large-scale IP concept spaces across text, image, and audio. 

Study how retrieval-augmented systems (RAG), embedding alignment, and structured knowledge can complement multimodal foundation models. 

Investigate strategies for improving long-tail concept coverage beyond what VLMs inherently encode. 

Design concept modeling techniques that meaningfully influence downstream guardrail decisions. 

Data Acquisition & Curation for Detection 

Develop scalable approaches for acquiring and curating high-quality multimodal datasets that improve detection coverage for IP-sensitive concepts. 

Drive long-tail expansion through targeted data collection, web-scale sourcing, and synthetic data generation. 

Analyze failure cases in generative outputs to inform targeted data acquisition and dataset refinement. 

Design efficient data curation and labeling strategies that improve signal quality and robustness of downstream detection systems. 

 

Evaluation Methodology & Benchmark Design 

Define evaluation frameworks that reflect real-world Firefly usage patterns. 

Design multimodal benchmark datasets that stress-test guardrails under realistic and adversarial scenarios. 

Develop metrics that capture over-blocking, under-blocking, semantic similarity, and near-miss generation. 

Establish statistically rigorous offline and online evaluation strategies that guide research prioritization. 

Study how evaluation quality constrains and enables system-level progress. 

Feedback-Driven Scientific Iteration 

Leverage large-scale product feedback signals to identify systematic weaknesses in guardrail behavior. 

Translate real-world interaction patterns into structured evaluation hypotheses. 

Build reproducible experimental pipelines that enable continuous scientific iteration. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Lead scientific design of IP concept expansion and detection methodologies. 

Formulate hypotheses around long-tail coverage, detection robustness, and evaluation gaps. 

Run rigorous experiments to quantify performance ceilings and identify high-leverage improvements. 

Partner closely with generative model scientists to ensure alignment between detection, guidance, and evaluation systems. 

Contribute to intellectual property and potential publications in multimodal learning, evaluation science, or AI safety. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related field. 

5+ years of experience in applied ML, multimodal systems, or evaluation research. 

Strong understanding of Vision-Language Models, multimodal transformers, and embedding-based retrieval systems. 

Experience designing and analyzing large-scale benchmarks and evaluation datasets. 

Solid background in statistical analysis, experimental design, and performance trade-off evaluation. 

Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). 

Scientific Approach 

Ability to reason about long-tail distributions and concept coverage gaps. 

Experience analyzing complex multimodal system failure modes. 

Strong intuition for measurement of quality and evaluation bias. 

Comfort operating in ambiguous, research-driven problem spaces. 

AI-Accelerated Research Execution 

Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to rapidly prototype evaluation frameworks, detection experiments, and data analysis. 

Ability to scale scientific insight through high-velocity experimentation. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience in safety evaluation, trust & safety systems, or content moderation science. 

Background in retrieval-augmented systems, knowledge graph modeling, or large-scale embedding systems. 

Publications in venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, or equivalent industry research impact. 

Experience translating evaluation science into deployed guardrail improvements.

Generative AI is redefining creativity. Ensuring that these systems are safe, controllable, and respectful of intellectual property is one of the most important open research challenges in the field. 

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is building next-generation multimodal guardrail systems for building safe and compliant image, video, and audio generative models powering Firefly.com. Our goal extends beyond reactive blocking; we are developing model-level guidance mechanisms that proactively steer generation away from IP-violating concepts while preserving creative intent and usability. 

We are seeking a Applied Scientist with strong multimodal depth and research instincts to help define and develop the frontier of IP-aware generative modeling. This role sits at the intersection of generative model alignment, multimodal reasoning, and large-scale inference systems. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Inference-Time Alignment & Optimization 

Research and implement inference-time control techniques (guided decoding, constrained sampling, classifier guidance, reward-based steering). 

Optimize large multimodal systems for low-latency, production-scale deployment without sacrificing alignment quality. 

Identify and mitigate failure modes in generative pipelines at scale. 

Rapid Scientific Experimentation 

Develop and complete rigorous experiments to evaluate trade-offs between creativity, fidelity, and IP safety. 

Develop new evaluation methodologies and benchmarks for multimodal IP compliance. 

Contribute novel technical insights that may lead to publications or internal intellectual property. 

Vision-Language & Multimodal Reasoning 

Advance the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and multimodal foundation models for semantic IP understanding. 

Explore joint reasoning between perception and generation systems to enable real-time steering. 

Experiment how various techniques, e.g. multimodal embeddings, cross-attention mechanisms, etc., can be used for safety-aware inference. 

Multimodal IP-Aware Generative Modeling 

Develop novel approaches for integrating IP constraints directly into generative model behavior. 

Investigate controllable generation techniques that shift models from post-hoc blocking toward guided, alignment-aware synthesis. 

Develop training and fine-tuning strategies that embed guardrail signals into model representations. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Architect and evolve the Firefly IP Guard pipeline across first-party and third-party generative models. 

Collaborate with research scientists, ML engineers and other key partners like applied ethics, legal etc., to translate scientific advances into deployed systems. 

Communicate with other non-technical collaborators to help drive awareness about the implemented technologies. 

Drive end-to-end experimentation, from hypothesis formulation through model implementation and large-scale evaluation. 

Contribute to the broader research strategy around generative AI alignment and safety within Adobe. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related field. 

5+ years of experience in applied ML or generative AI research (industry or academia). 

Strong background in large-scale generative models (diffusion models, multimodal transformers, autoregressive systems). 

Deep experience with model fine-tuning, alignment strategies, and representation learning. 

Expertise in Vision-Language Models or multimodal foundation models. 

Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch), with experience of training and deploying large models. 

Scientific & Systems Rigor 

Strong experimental development and statistical evaluation skills. 

Experience analyzing complex failure modes in multimodal systems. 

Understanding of large-scale inference systems and production ML constraints. 

Ability to navigate open-ended research spaces and identify high-leverage problems. 

AI-Accelerated Development 

Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools and AI-assisted development workflows to rapidly prototype, experiment, and scale research impact. 

Comfort operating in an AI-augmented development environment, using generative tools to increase iteration speed, code quality, and research throughput. 

Ability to combine scientific rigor with high-velocity execution. 

Collaborative Approach 

Experience working in cross-functional research-to-product environments. 

Ability to clearly communicate complex scientific ideas to diverse collaborators. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

Research contributions in controllable generation, alignment, AI safety, or multimodal learning. 

Publications in leading conferences (CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) or equivalent industry impact. 

Experience deploying generative models to large user bases. 

Background in safety evaluation frameworks, explainability or adversarial robustness.

Generative AI is redefining creativity. Ensuring that these systems are safe, controllable, and respectful of intellectual property is one of the most important open challenges in deploying generative models responsibly at scale. 

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is building a unified guardrails platform that enables safe training and deployment of generative models across image, video, and audio. This includes large-scale automated data moderation systems, multimodal detection and safety mechanisms, and learning based on input that continuously improves system robustness. 

We are seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to help architect and scale this platform while leading key applied ML initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of multimodal machine learning, large-scale ML systems, and production AI safety infrastructure. The ideal candidate will drive high-impact technical initiatives while defining the architectural patterns that enable guardrail systems to scale across models, products, and enterprise use cases. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Guardrails Platform Architecture 

Architect end-to-end systems that integrate data pipelines, detection, evaluation, and model control mechanisms. 

Optimize systems for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency under real-world constraints. 

Define reusable patterns that generalize across products and enterprise deployments. 

Identify and address system-level bottlenecks to ensure scalable and reliable deployment. 

 

Safety-Aware Data Systems 

Develop strategies to identify and mitigate intellectual property and trust & safety risks in large-scale datasets. 

Advance methods to improve coverage and robustness of safety systems, particularly across long-tail and evolving concept spaces. 

Drive system-level thinking around efficiency, scalability, and reliability of data-centric safety mechanisms. 

Partner with modeling teams to ensure data quality and safety signals effectively translate into improved model behavior. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Lead the architectural development of scalable, data-centric safety and guardrail systems across multimodal ML platforms. 

Drive applied ML initiatives spanning data-centric safety, detection, and feedback-driven system improvement. 

Translate research advances into production-ready systems, balancing model quality, scalability, and efficiency. 

Act as a technical lead and mentor, guiding applied scientists and engineers while setting high standards for system design and execution. 

Shape the long-term technical strategy for building robust, scalable, and responsible generative AI systems at Adobe. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field. 

8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership. 

Strong expertise in multimodal machine learning, including vision-language and generative models. 

Experience working with large-scale datasets and applying data-centric approaches to improve system performance and robustness. 

Proficiency in modern ML development ecosystems (e.g., Python, PyTorch), with the ability to translate research into scalable implementations. 

ML Systems Architecture 

Experience designing scalable ML systems under real-world production constraints. 

Strong intuition for trade-offs between model quality, latency, and infrastructure cost. 

Experience integrating ML systems into large-scale product environments. 

Scientific & Systems Rigor 

Strong experimental design and evaluation skills. 

Experience analyzing complex system-level failure modes.

Job Details

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

RAG System Design:

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion:

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization:

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement:

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support:

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring:

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

Qualifications

Required:

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred:

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Success in This Role Looks Like:

High-recall, low-latency retrieval pipelines that enhance LLM outputs with accurate, relevant context

Modular, reusable RAG components that can be applied across use cases and domains

Continuous improvement of retrieval relevance and reasoning alignment through experimentation and monitoring

Strong collaboration with AI engineers, prompt engineers, and data owners to maintain data quality and user trust

As a Senior Partner Manager at Adobe, you will take ownership of one of our most strategic Global System Integrator (GSI) partnerships, with primary responsibility for Germany and an additional overlay role across Adobe Central Europe, working closely with regional Partner Alliance Managers.

This role sits at the heart of Adobe’s growth strategy, with a clear mandate to scale partner-led pipeline, revenue, and customer impact across the Adobe Digital Experience Cloud. You will define and execute the joint strategy with a top-tier global partner, aligning Adobe’s technology, industry solutions, and go-to-market motions with the integrator’s consulting, delivery, and services capabilities across the German market, while ensuring regional consistency and leverage across Central Europe.

Operating in a complex, matrixed environment, you will engage with stakeholders ranging from alliance leaders and solution architects to senior executives and C-level decision-makers. Your success will be measured by your ability to translate strategic alignment into tangible business outcomes—accelerating partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, driving customer adoption, and building a scalable, high-impact partnership model across the region.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will act as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for a global systems integrator in Germany, while collaborating with other Partner Alliance Managers to support and extend the partnership across Central Europe. You will shape joint priorities, lead executive alignment, and ensure disciplined execution across sales, marketing, and delivery teams.

You will develop and own Joint Business Plans that define shared objectives, investment areas, and success metrics, covering pipeline creation, bookings, customer adoption, and services attach. Working closely with Adobe Sales and Customer Success teams, you will ensure partner opportunities are identified early, properly registered, and executed seamlessly through to customer success.

A key part of the role is driving go-to-market impact. You will collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Partner Solution Consulting teams to design joint industry plays, solution offerings, and demand-generation initiatives. This includes sponsoring and shaping executive events, campaigns, and thought leadership activities that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue growth in Germany, while aligning with broader Central Europe priorities.

As a senior leader within Adobe’s partner ecosystem, you will bring a strong point of view on digital experience transformation, advising partners and customers on market trends and how Adobe’s full Experience Cloud portfolio can address their most critical business challenges. You will also play an important role in fostering a culture of accountability, ambition, and continuous improvement across the partnership and the wider regional partner community.

What You need to succeed

You bring extensive experience in enterprise sales and strategic partnerships, with a proven track record of delivering results through large, complex partners. You have spent several years working directly with Global System Integrators or major consulting firms, ideally with strong exposure to the German market and experience operating across multiple countries or regions.

You combine strong commercial acumen with executive presence, enabling you to influence senior leaders and drive alignment at the highest levels. You are experienced in building and scaling partner businesses, developing joint value propositions, and translating strategy into execution that delivers measurable outcomes across both local and regional contexts.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, a proactive and resilient mindset, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. A bachelor’s degree is required; a master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred.

Responsibilities:

Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing product instrumentation and help bridge gaps in data streams to assist data science initiatives.

Analyze product usage patterns to better understand customer behavior including acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Proactively identify user trends and communicate relevant insights to assist product decision-making.

Automate and optimize data pipelines using SQL and/or Python-based ETL Frameworks.

Build and maintain various dashboards to inform the team about the state of the business, as well as to alert business partners when issues occur.

Architect and implement models to recommend personalized in-app content.

Drive A/B and multivariate tests and build feature-level experiments to validate hypotheses and influence product development decisions.

Requirements:

MS or Ph.D. in data science, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or economics, or equivalent experience.

3 - 5+ years of relevant data science experience.

Experience translating business questions into data analytics approaches.

Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages (Hive, Spark, etc.).

Experience developing and operationalizing consistent approaches to experimentation, using appropriate statistical techniques to reduce bias and interpret statistical significance.

Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics (i.e., t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation, regression, etc.) to understand customer engagement and generate hypotheses.

Experience crafting data visualizations and storytelling to efficiently communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Knowledge of relevant tools in this field such as Hadoop, Hive, Splunk, Spark, Tableau, Excel (Charting and Pivot-Tables), and Power BI.

Experience in product instrumentation is a plus.

Possess natural curiosity and technical competence, being capable of asking critical questions and always ready to address any challenges.

Experience addressing an executive level audience.

Excellent communication, relationship skills, and a strong teammate.

The Acrobat Product Marketing team is seeking a strategic Director of Product Marketing, Engagement to lead our Value Discovery team with a focus on delivering meaningful impact. This leader will shape how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

They will define the strategy that connects product innovation to sustained customer value, ensuring new and existing capabilities are clearly positioned, prioritized effectively, and reinforced across the full customer lifecycle. This role owns the narrative and sequencing of key experiences so what we build is not only understood, but consistently used.

Working cross-functionally with teams such as Product, Growth, Lifecycle, GTM, and others, this leader will drive adoption, increase repeat engagement, and translate product improvements into measurable, long-term impact for the business.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the Value Discovery strategy, shaping how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

Design and operationalize a cross-channel engagement framework that ensures new and existing capabilities are introduced, reinforced, and re-surfaced at the right moments across the customer lifecycle.

Develop engagement messaging framework for key capabilities grounded in user value and existing workflows

Build an always-on content strategy that employs trends, cultural moments, and seasonal events to promote new and existing value

Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Design, Growth, Lifecycle to align engagement strategy with roadmap priorities and business goals.

Embed audience expertise, behavioral insights and adoption data into strategic decision-making to influence product direction.

Drive measurable improvements in feature adoption, depth of usage, and multi-tool engagement.

What We’re Looking For

A strategic product marketing leader who drives behavior change—not just awareness.

A builder of scalable engagement systems, not one-off campaigns.

A strong cross-functional operator who can influence Product, Growth, Lifecycle, Design, and GTM partners and align teams around shared adoption goals.

A problem solver with a customer-first approach who translates workflows and user insights into clear, compelling value narratives.

A data-driven operator who uses adoption metrics, usage patterns, and experimentation to continuously refine strategy.

A leader who can balance long-term critical thinking alongside hands-on execution and operational excellence.

A compelling storyteller who can articulate value in a way that drives clarity, urgency, and action internally and externally.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

10+ years in Product Marketing, Engagement, Lifecycle, or a related field in a subscription-based business, with clear ownership of adoption and engagement metrics.

Proven track record of increasing feature adoption, usage depth, retention, or multi-product engagement.

Experience building cross-channel engagement strategies (in-product, email, paid, owned).

Comfort working closely with Product & Design teams, shaping roadmaps through customer insight, influencing prioritization, and embedding go-to-market thinking into product development.

Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and prioritize investments.

Experience building and leading high-performing teams and influencing senior partners.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to drive clarity and alignment across functions.

A passion for modernizing a legacy product with a clear vision for how AI can drive everyday utility, prove ongoing value, and unlock Acrobat’s next phase of growth.

The Opportunity

As a Principal Instructor at Adobe, you will be at the forefront of delivering outstanding learning experiences within our Premium Learning Subscription organization. You will bring to bear your deep technical expertise and instructional excellence to significantly impact both customer happiness and internal standards.

You will engage with a diverse range of learning audiences - including executives, business users, system administrators, and developers, across various Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration platforms. Your role will extend beyond training delivery to include crafting curriculum, mentoring peers, and collaborating with global Adobe teams to ensure customer success. This outstanding position allows you to travel up to 50%, providing you the chance to lead high impact engagements!

What You Will Do

Deliver expert level Instructor Led (ILT) and Virtual Instructor Led (VILT) training for global, enterprise audiences.

Build and deliver prescriptive education solutions aligned to complex customer use cases.

Act as a trusted advisor during learning needs analysis and course prioritization discussions.

Own training engagements end to end, from preparation through post delivery follow up.

Mentor and support instructors, helping develop delivery quality and technical depth.

Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for your practice, contributing to curriculum evolution and delivery standards.

Lead or contribute to delivery improvement initiatives, including curriculum refreshes and new course enablement.

Communicate with clarity and confidence to influence customers and internal collaborators.

What You Need to Succeed

Experience & Background

10–15 years of experience in technical training, enterprise software, or technology consulting.

10+ years delivering instructor led training or technical presentations.

8+ years of hands on experience with Customer Experience Orchestration and/or MarTech solutions.

Equivalent combination of education and practical technical experience.

Technical Expertise

Proficiency in Git, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Experience with modern web architectures, including SPAs and headless delivery.

Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, SQL, and API testing tools (e.g., Postman).

Familiarity with data models, schemas, and enterprise data structures.

Customer Experience Orchestration background strongly preferred.

Certifications & Professional Attributes

Three or more Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration certifications across multiple solution areas.

Strong customer presence and ability to translate complex concepts for diverse audiences.

Passion for customer success, learning excellence, and continuous improvement.

Comfortable working independently while collaborating across global teams.

The Opportunity

Adobe is transforming the enterprise content supply chain with intelligent brand solutions that redefine how large organizations create, govern, and scale content. At the core of this transformation is Brand Brain, a first-of-its-kind AI system that captures an enterprise’s business context and brand identity, enabling teams to create and validate content that is consistently on-brand across tools, workflows, and channels.

We are looking for a Senior Developer to build of Brand Brain’s core services and infrastructure. This role is ideal for a senior full stack engineer who can design and build these key AI-powered content workflows that will help organizations create on-brand assets at scale. You will work across backend, AI orchestration layers, creative tooling, agentic workflows etc. This role sits at the intersection of creativity, engineering craftsmanship, and applied AI.

Impact You’ll Make

You will have an opportunity to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and can take a feature from concept to production. You will help architect build technology that helps enterprises create on-brand content at scale by building robust backend services, APIs and platforms that integrate Brand Brain into Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise apps.

The Opportunity

Adobe leads in creating world-class software solutions, and we are excited to welcome a new Software Development Engineer 5 to our vibrant team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. This is an outstanding chance to join a cooperative and driven environment where your work directly influences the success of innovative projects.

Responsibilities

Architect and deliver foundational systems that enable enterprises to build on-brand content at a global scale.

Develop strong backend services, APIs, and integration layers that embed Brand Brain deeply within the Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise platforms.

Drive engineering excellence across performance, reliability, observability, and secure-by-default building.

Contribute to crafting long-term platform architecture in a fast-paced, highly visible product area.

What You’ll Do

Define and evolve foundational architecture, including service boundaries, domain models, APIs, and internal platform capabilities supporting high-throughput, low-latency workloads.

Build and implement scalable microservices and AI orchestration layers powering intelligent content workflows and agentic systems.

Build strong APIs and connectors that connect Brand Brain with Adobe products and third-party enterprise software.

Ensure platform compliance with strict SLAs for availability, scalability, latency, and data governance.

Establish guidelines for observability, incident management, prioritization, and cost efficiency.

Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI-powered features to validate new product experiences.

Improve engineering quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and technical mentorship.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of experience building high-quality backend systems and microservices with strong emphasis on scalability, resilience, and performance.

Deep proficiency in backend development using Python or Java (both preferred).

Strong experience designing, building, and operating RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs at scale.

Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed systems.

Strong foundation in system build, modern architecture patterns, and engineering guidelines.

Demonstrated ability to take features from concept to production in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Build, and AI/ML teams.

Nice to Have

Experience in AdTech, MarTech, Content Management Systems (CMS), or enterprise SaaS platforms.

Familiarity with large-scale data platforms, indexing, or search systems.

Experience integrating platforms across complex product ecosystems.

Exposure to Adobe or third-party creative ecosystems (e.g., Photoshop, Express, InDesign, Figma).

Experience shipping AI-powered features or working with agentic workflows.

The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our dynamic Multimodal Data Research team in Romania! This is an outstanding chance to build the data foundation behind Adobe Firefly's generative and editing models. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale data infrastructure and production ML, ensuring our foundational AI systems are fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.

What you'll Do

Build and optimize scalable data management pipelines for multimodal training data.

Develop reusable data processing frameworks and components for the feature platform.

Develop and maintain data quality, lineage, and governance tooling.

Integrate semantic search and vector database infrastructure.

Build and optimize distributed batch and real-time inference pipelines using technologies such as Apache Ray.

Implement backend services for ML inference workflows.

Partner with product and research teams to translate model requirements into production-ready capabilities.

Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing.

5+ years of experience with large-scale distributed systems and ML infrastructure.

Strong hands-on experience with ML inference optimization and GPU utilization.

Deep proficiency with ML frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Strong cloud expertise (AWS or Azure).

Strong proficiency in Python.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong history of publishing in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas.

Cross-Application Growth: Scale our products within Adobe’s creative ecosystem by integrating workflows and optimizing acquisition funnels across internal and external touchpoints.

Portfolio Lifecycle Management (LCM): Develop our LCM system and omnichannel methods (email, push, in-app messaging, SMS or comparable experience) aimed at improving user engagement and retention.

What You Will Do

Drive Cross-Application Growth Strategies

Workflow Integration: Build cross-application workflows and incorporate Firefly's Generative AI tools into Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere.

Journey Optimization: Manage end-to-end user journeys.

Scale branded entry points across the product ecosystem. Support the development of a cross-app platform. Build viral loops and develop our trends and sharing roadmap to drive organic growth.

External Partnerships: Build strategic partnerships to define new entry points and workflows (e.g., LLM providers, hardware, and software partners).

Architect Portfolio Lifecycle Oversight (LCM)

Omnichannel Activation: Manage LCM channels across the Creator portfolio, including push, in-app, email, SMS, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Google Play.

Evergreen Engagement: Direct the evergreen LCM strategy with Outbound Product Marketing to sustain user engagement between major product releases.

Infrastructure Acceleration: Partner with Product and Engineering to advance infrastructure.

Platform modernization: Explore new ways to bring to bear Gen AI technologies to engage users and drive operational excellence.

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Execution & Growth Operations

Growth Operations: Lead high-velocity multivariate testing frameworks to optimize acquisition funnels, monetization models, and user flows.

Product-Led Growth (PLG): Operationalize PLG loops - such as sharing, referrals, and asset remixing to improve user acquisition.

Executive Alignment: Align Engineering, Build, Product, and Marketing around unified growth objectives. Translate growth analytics into clear executive reporting.

Mobile & Web Expertise: Deep experience driving user acquisition, retention, and monetization strategies for applications.

Lifecycle & Ecosystem Experience: Proficiency in managing complex LCM channels and growth loops. Hands-on experience with enterprise marketing automation infrastructure (e.g., Adobe Journey Optimizer) is highly preferred.

Quantitative Rigor: Strong analytical skills. Demonstrated capability in cohort analysis, funnel optimization, user profiling, and A/B/multivariate experiment development.

Technical & Creative Proficiency: Ability to translate GenAI capabilities (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models) into intuitive value propositions for creative professionals in building, video, and imaging.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive collaborators, product managers, and engineering teams in a matrixed organization.

Under the general supervision of the Lead System Operator and Team Leader of System Operations, the Associate System Operator acting under the direction of the Lead System Operator is responsible for the safe, stable,
reliable, economical and environmentally correct operation of the Bulk Electric System.

This responsibility extends from the generating station substations through the distribution substations. The Associate System Operator is responsible for complying with NERC, FERC, RFC, IURC and MISO requirements and directing field personnel through switching operations involving the Bulk Electric System.

Primary Responsibilities:

Assists in a training capacity for the direct operation of the bulk electric system.

Assists the field switching operations performed by authorized personnel including Substation Inspectors/Switchmen, Substation Mechanics, Electricians, line Techs, Relay/SCADA Specialists, Trouble Techs and any other classification that may be required to operate equipment on the bulk electric system.

During emergency operating conditions, the Associate System Operator works with department management to take the necessary actions to protect the transmission system integrity, prevent loss of life and minimize damage to transmission system components.

Participates in conferring with the Lead System Operator and other System Operations management personnel regarding matters affecting the operation of the bulk electric system and with the operation personnel of the interconnected utilities on a twenty-four hour basis, exchanging information necessary to maintain good interconnected procedures.

Monitors system conditions for issues affecting bulk electric system reliability and recommends immediate corrective actions when abnormalities are detected to department management.

Associates degree showing an aptitude for math and electrical theory, to include previous work experience demonstrating basic electrical utility knowledge, or equivalent combination of education and/or experience related to the discipline.

High degree of electrical and mechanical aptitude.

Available for all System Operations shifts (24-7).

Ability to pass NERC Certification exam within 6 months

Preferred Skills:

Current NERC Certification

Electric Utility experience in transmission and/or distribution operations.

Computer proficiency and effective verbal and written communication skills are requirements.

Ability to work in a real-time operations environment on all shifts and as a team member.

Understanding of power substation equipment, power system electrical fundamentals, and the ability to interpret substation one-line diagrams and electrical schematics.

Successfully pass pre-screening EEI exam System Operator/Power Dispatch (SOPD) preferred.

Electric utility job related experience or training

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Robotics Perception and AI Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, optimizing and implementing cutting-edge perception and AI algorithms to enable our robots to understand and interact with the world around them. You will leverage your deep expertise in computer vision, machine learning, and robotics to drive innovation and solve complex challenges. Duties will include developing advanced perception algorithms for tasks such as object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation, as well as leading the technical roadmap for the perception part aligned with our vision and Product Roadmap.

A successful candidate is strongly motivated and passionate about solving perception and AI/ML problems and pushing the boundaries of what is possible today and will be an entrepreneurial, mission-driven individual responsible for actively progressing, developing, and executing the technical roadmap of our solar module installation robotic system. This individual will take on the responsibility of defining, designing, and implementing the perception software stack architecture and guide the Robotics and Hardware engineers to identify the best sensor suite. In addition, this person will take the ownership of developing and maintaining machine learning pipeline, deploying new models to production, and monitoring their performance collaborating closely with the engineer team to ensure seamless integration of machine learning models and perception algorithm into our applications.

As a specialist in the Maximo business, this position will work collaboratively across the Maximo, external industry partners across the value chain, and AES teams, including engineering, business development, construction, finance, supply chain, and strategy. 

Major Responsibilities

Develop and implement advanced high-performing perception algorithms for real-time tasks such as object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation based on variety of sensor data (Lidar, Camera, etc)

Design, train, optimize, deploy and maintain AI/ML models for robust and accurate perception in challenging environments.

Enhance our machine learning pipeline and related tools to support development, experimentation, continuous integration, continuous delivery, verification/validation, and monitoring of AI/ML models in the field.

Integrate perception systems with robotic platforms to enable autonomous manipulation, navigation, and human-robot interaction.

Analyze and process sensor data (e.g., camera, lidar, radar, etc.) to extract meaningful information.

Translate product level requirements into technical design criteria.

Work with engineers (robotics, hardware, etc.) and product team to define hardware/software architecture and technical roadmap 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, software engineers, and control engineers, to ensure seamless integration of perception systems.

Stay up to date with the latest advancements in computer vision, machine learning, and robotics to drive innovation and improve product performance.

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

Requirements

Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.

5+ years of experience in computer vision, machine learning, and/or robotics.

Strong theoretical foundation in computer vision, image processing, and machine learning algorithms.

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and ROS2.

Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).

Experience with real-time systems and embedded platforms.

Knowledge of robotics platforms and sensor systems.

Founder’s mentality: Entrepreneurial passion for getting things done and a “make it happen” attitude with an intellectual curiosity to seek new opportunities.

Skill and Behavior: Capability to work dynamically and collaboratively across multiple teams in a fast-paced and technical business environment with minimal supervision. Excellent communication skills. Results-oriented, “can-do” attitude, and “get things done” mentality; comfortable with uncertainty and ambiguity; no compromise on attention to quality and details.

Technology fluency: Demonstrated ability to understand solar engineering and technology concepts, question assumptions, and make informed product and technology decisions. Technical understanding of automation, robotics, computer vision, machine learning and/or artificial intelligence, is a plus.

Travel: 30% travel

The Transmission Planning Analysis Engineer will be responsible for conducting studies in connection with the 34.5 kV, 69 kV, 138 kV, 230 kV and 345 kV transmission system to ensure the operational reliability, adequacy, and security based on FERC 715. This work includes analysis of and studies for power flow, dynamic-stability, transient-stability, and voltage-stability. 

Job Responsibilities 

Annual NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Assessment using steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamics power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as governed by FERC 715. 

Annual NERC CIP-014 Physical Security assessment modeling realistic and historical physical attacks on transmission equipment to determine if said physical attack could result in instability, uncontrolled separation, or Cascading within an��electrical Interconnection utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, and DSA Tools. 

As requested NERC FAC-002 qualified changes and material modification impact studies to determine if any new or materially modified load (including Large Loads and Data Centers), any new or materially modified generation, or any new or materially modified transmission results in an inability of the Transmission System to meet the performance requirements of FERC 715 using as applicable steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamic power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as governed by FERC 715. 

Evaluate the optimization of the Transmission System and proposed Transmission plans to reduce overall investment driving downward pressure on electric rates utilizing traditional and all new relevant and upcoming technologies such as GETs.

Participate in stakeholder meetings of, Plan projects within, and Evaluate MISO’s Expedited Project Review (EPR) and Expediate Resource Adequacy Study (ERAS) to ensure effective, efficient, and thorough evaluation of Transmission Projects ensuring just and reasonable Transmission scope using steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamics power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as governed by FERC 715. 

Collaborate amongst Indiana’s five vertically integrated Investor-Owned Utilities and two Generation & Transmission Cooperatives to establish a cost-effective forecasted Transmission Plan that reliably serves existing and new Indiana customers. 

Prepare for and defend against regulatory audits of entities including but not limited to NERC, IURC, FERC, and MISO for adherence to Transmission Tariffs, Distribution Tariff, and NERC compliance. 

Provide the Transmission Operations Control Center assistance in times of emergency such as extreme weather events, emergency repairs, or system restoration to ensure a timely return to energization of AES Indiana’s customers.

Digital Workplace Sr. System Engineer (VMware Horizon / Virtual Environment Specialist)

Location: On-site, Indianapolis
Remote Options: Not Available

Overview
The Digital Workplace Sr. System Engineer is part of a global team that delivers innovative technology (hardware, software, and services) with a strong focus on user experience. The team is a key component of AES’s Digital Workplace Experience (DWX) organization.

This role plays a primary role in supporting, managing, and advancing AES’s VMware Horizon View virtual desktop environment, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and scalability across our global enterprise. Hands-on experience in VMware Horizon View, FSLogix, and App Volumes in an enterprise environment is required for this position.

Beyond virtualization, the role supports end-user computing technologies that span device management systems, end-user hardware, and printers, providing a consistent and secure user experience that meets AES’s global standards for performance, supportability, and data protection.

This position is responsible for endpoint configuration management including PCs, tablets, and phones, as well as application deployment, client virtualization, process development, and printer management.

AES is a Fortune 500 global power company that operates on four continents.

Your Role

As a member of our Global Digital Workplace Experience & Collaborations team, you deliver modern digital experiences with a focus on user satisfaction and reliability. You play a critical role in ensuring that AES employees have an optimized, secure, and high-performing virtual desktop experience—from anywhere, on any device.

You Are Perfect for This Position If You Have:

Initiative – You are a self-starter who voluntarily chooses to be engaged.

Adaptability – You naturally manage change or conflict with an optimistic and open mind.

Communication Skills – You collaborate and work well across teams, improving productivity and creating synergies.

Resilience – You solve problems, learn from failures, and grow from experiences.

What You’ll Do

As our Digital Workplace Sr. System Engineer, you will:

Serve as the primary technical owner of AES’s VMware Horizon View virtual desktop environment, ensuring stability, performance, and scalability.

Manage and optimize FSLogix profiles and App Volumes for efficient application delivery and user experience.

Support and enhance AES’s virtual infrastructure, collaborating closely with global teams to improve performance and maintain best practices.

Create and maintain software deployment packages, manage automation initiatives, and develop process improvements for scalability and self-service capabilities.

Evaluate software requests and make recommendations aligned with AES business needs and industry standards.

Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex virtual environment and endpoint issues.

Analyze and mitigate vulnerabilities, ensuring compliance with AES’s security and operational policies.

Develop and maintain detailed technical documentation, standards, and procedures.

Provide technical guidance to team members, engage with vendors, and support budget and lifecycle planning for digital workplace technologies.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and/or equivalent technical training or experience.

5+ years’ experience in enterprise systems administration with a strong focus on VMware Horizon View and virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI).

Hands-on expertise with FSLogix and App Volumes in a large-scale production environment (required).

Strong knowledge of:

Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy

TCP/IP networking protocols, LAN/WAN

Azure and Remote Desktop Services (RDS)

Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM) and Intune

Windows 11, SQL Reporting, and PowerShell scripting

Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Strong teamwork, adaptability, communication, and problem-solving skills.

We are looking for a SAP Master Data Analyst to join our AES Clean Energy team:

AES’s mission is to improve lives by accelerating a safer and greener energy future. We are a global, agile, cohesive organization with an employee engagement level akin to a startup company. AES businesses throughout the world are often recognized as great places to work. Our people share a passion to help meet the world’s current and increasing energy needs, while providing communities and countries the opportunity for economic growth due to the availability of reliable, affordable electric power. 

 

A day in the life of an AES Clean Energy, SAP Master Data Analyst will include, but is not limited to: 

Creating Functional Location Hierarchies from equipment lists and as-builts drawings for PV Solar and Battery Storage assets, leveraging reliability engineering resources. 

Managing and modifying master data for existing functional locations. 

Mastering and owning the process for data migration into and from SAP. 

Implementing new practices to improve uptime and efficiency. 

 

The SAP Master Data Analyst supports a larger operations team and serves as the domain expert for SAP Fiori and Prometheus master data as it relates to the operation of photovoltaic plants, grid-scale battery storage systems and wind turbines. Excellent communication, task management and planning skills needed, in addition to technical breadth. Attention to detail and process adherence are mandatory. 

 

The successful applicant, while not an expert, will be or become comfortable with high-level review of practical renewable power generation system design and the associated equipment. 

 

The position can be located in Louisville, CO / Salt Lake City, UT / Indianapolis, IN / Arlington, VA / Houston TX (Other US AES office locations available) and may include up to 5% travel to project locations and partner offices. The candidate must be located within the US territory. 

 

Key Responsibilities

Master Data Management 

Maintain and control master data within SAP Plant Maintenance systems, including Fiori 

Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of master data records by performing regular audits and data validation checks. 

Implement data governance policies and procedures to uphold data quality standards and compliance requirements. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements and define data standards for SAP master data. 

Process MD notification requests. 

Create FLOC and Equipment records for Solar/BESS and Wind Assets. 

Create and Maintain BOMs for clean energy assets. 

Data Integrity and Accuracy: 

Investigate and cleanse master data to eliminate duplicates, errors, and inconsistencies. 

Monitor data entry processes and enforce data integrity rules to prevent data quality issues. 

Process Improvement: 

Identify opportunities to streamline master data management processes and enhance system functionalities. 

Propose system enhancements or automation solutions to optimize data management efficiency. 

User Support and Training: 

Provide guidance and support to end-users on master data-related inquiries, issues, and procedures. 

Conduct training sessions to educate users on SAP master data processes, data entry standards, and data governance policies. 

Act as a subject matter expert on SAP master data management, offering expertise and assistance to stakeholders as needed. 

Documentation and Reporting: 

Maintain documentation of master data processes, procedures, and system configurations. 

Generate reports and metrics related to master data quality, integrity, and compliance. 

Analyze data trends and identify areas for improvement based on report findings. 

 

Qualifications and Skills: 

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field. 

Proven experience (2 years+) working with SAP ERP systems, with a focus on master data management. Experience in Fiori is recommended, and SAP PM (plant maintenance) module experience is highly recommended.

In-depth knowledge of SAP master data structures, data objects, and configuration settings. 

Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze complex data sets and identify data discrepancies. (Beyond excel skills)

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data management and validation. 

Proficiency in data cleansing and manipulation techniques. 

Effective communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and providing user support. 

Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. 

Knowledge of data governance principles, best practices, and regulatory requirements. 

Proficiency with reading and understanding equipment/facility schematics 

Well versed in the use of the Microsoft Office software suite 

Experience in using results of data analytics and database tools (GCP, Git, etc.)

High degree of commitment to a quality safety culture and an incident-free work environment 

Personal values consistent with those of the AES Corporation; Safety, Integrity, Excellence, Agility and Fun 

“Plus” Qualifications 

Certification in SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) is a plus. 

Familiarity with renewable energy generation equipment and one-line electrical diagrams 

Spanish language skills

DEPARTMENT: Interconnection, Grid Integration Group 

REPORTS TO: Manager, Interconnection 

LOCATION: Remote, San Francisco CA, Long Beach CA, Salt Lake City UT, Louisville CO, New York, NY, or Richmond, VA 

 

The Grid Integration group is responsible for siting and interconnecting the AES Clean Energy portfolio to transmission systems across the United States. The group consists of a Transmission Strategy team, Interconnection team, High Voltage Engineering team, and a Generation Modelling and Technical Compliance team. 

 

The primary responsibilities of this role are: strategic analysis of the interconnection procedures, queue and transmission system in a given RTO/ISO to formulate and steer greenfield project siting, and to then prepare and manage interconnection requests through to an Interconnection Agreement with the most favorable terms possible. The Interconnection Project Engineer supports the Interconnection (IC) Regional Lead on progressing projects through the interconnection process and working cross functionally with the broader Development Team to optimize the position throughout the development lifecycle. 

 

The preferred candidate has experience in: the preparation and review of interconnection requests; review and management of PSS/E and/or PSLF models; and participating in the management of solar and wind projects through the generator interconnection processes including negotiation and execution of Generator Interconnection Agreements. Additional responsibilities include monitoring the progress of required system upgrades and identifying creative mitigation solutions when needed within the applicable open access transmission tariff. 

 

Principal Duties and Responsibilities: 

The Interconnection Project Engineer will support and lead when necessary, all interconnection activities through the full life cycle of development and construction of projects. The position will support the IC Regional Lead and other internal stakeholders leading to the successful execution of both new and acquired projects across the United States. Some travel required (~15-20%). 

Support of greenfield development: review transmission system analysis, lead the identification of interconnection agencies and procedures, help lead preparation and filing interconnection requests including leading internal and external parties on preparation of technical materials, provide viability feedback to the IC Regional Lead and other internal stakeholders to support any financial and project approvals needed. 

Interconnection study process: lead and support the review and analysis of utility study reports; help lead tracking and reporting of results throughout process; help lead negotiation and execution of interconnection agreements and engineering and procurement agreements. 

Implementation of portfolio projects: lead assistance of internal groups to complete deliverables required by transmission owners to construct interconnection facilities including integrating schedules of Transmission Owner into project construction schedule. 

Support and lead project due diligence efforts, identify existing and potential red flags for project acquisitions. 

 

Desired Skills and Expertise: 

In depth knowledge reviewing interconnection studies and familiarity with power flow models. Experience running study models a plus. 

Strong ability to analyze power flow and system impact studies for interconnection of utility scale solar, wind, and storage generating facilities. 

In depth knowledge of System Impact Studies (SIS) and other interconnection studies of renewable energy generating facilities in the respective region. 

Experienced understanding of electrical diagrams, preliminary site plans, and preparation of interconnection request packages for submittal. 

Awareness of transmission systems and transmission expansion plans in US. 

Strong knowledge of Open Access Transmission Tariffs and Generator Interconnection Procedures. 

 

Minimum Qualifications: 

BS in Electrical Engineering or related field. 

4+ years work history in renewable or traditional energy development, utility generation development, or transmission planning. Previous employment or experience working at an Electric Utility, or consultants providing services within those footprints is strongly preferred.

AES Clean Energy is recruiting for the position of Manager within the Transmission Strategy department. The Transmission Strategy department is responsible for performing transmission system analysis to steer AES Clean Energy greenfield prospecting efforts and support the interconnection for our large utility-scale project portfolio. This is an outstanding opportunity for individual who is passionate about renewable energy and seeking high-growth work environment. The Transmission Strategy department actively tracks and analyzes transmission systems not just as they exist today, but how they will exist in the future. The department is instrumental in the strategic siting efforts of the entire development platform. The position will be responsible to set up and run a variety of innovative, automated power flow studies using power flow and coding software. As an internal power flow study expert, this position will work with internal Strategic Development team, and external entities including Transmission Owners, ISO/RTO to review, analyze and replicate generator interconnection study results.

The person could be based in one of our EAST region offices or work remotely. Some travel will be required (~10%).

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

In partnership with internal stakeholders, lead to the successful execution of both new and acquired projects across the United States.

Analyze transmission grid to identify new opportunities for interconnecting renewable energy projects (i.e. solar, storage, wind).

Spearhead power flow analysis such as First Contingency Incremental Transfer Capability (FCITC), injection analysis, replicating key market and region deliverability studies.

Ability to set up and conduct automated power flow analysis using Python, or other scripting languages to expedite the analysis process.

Perform injection studies to identify the optimal interconnection locations for the placement of generator resources across the targeted study/focus region.

Actively track and participate in regions Transmission Planning Process, and advocate for AES clean energy portfolio to be included in Long Term Planning process.

The Senior Project Engineer on the Mega and M&A Engineering team will be responsible for design and engineering of utility scale solar PV and energy storage projects in development and construction phases. Responsibilities include lead and support engineering activities across the full project lifecycle, including design development and peer reviews, energy and performance modeling, equipment selection and specifications, and preparation of engineering calculations. Provide technical inputs to support Engineer Procure Construct (EPC) pricing estimates, RFP responses, permitting applications, design drafting, and technical due diligence for M&A project evaluations. Responsibilities also include engineering management, development and review of contract documents, participation in technical negotiations, preparation of procurement specifications, punch list development, and delivery of ongoing technical support throughout project execution.

Designs will be developed, optimized, analyzed, and reviewed using industry-standard tools, including PVsyst, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS, MS Office, and SharePoint. This role will provide technical leadership across multiple projects by defining design-phase roadmaps, establishing development engineering standards and processes, and training and mentoring junior engineers. The successful candidate will manage complex, multi-project priorities, communicate progress to the Senior Manager of Mega and M&A Engineering, and operate effectively with distributed and remote teams. A strong background in the development, execution, analysis, and design of utility-scale, transmission-interconnected PV and battery energy storage systems is required, along with a demonstrated ability and commitment to coaching and developing engineering talent. Experience with additional renewable technologies such as wind, green hydrogen, or hydroelectric systems is a plus. Excellent communication, planning, and task-management skills, combined with broad technical expertise, are essential for success in this role.

The position is in Louisville, CO / Houston, TX / Salt Lake City, UT / or New York, NY and may include up to 25% travel to project locations and partner offices, including international travel.

Project Development

M&A

Perform full technical due diligence and risk assessment for the M&A projects

Full project design evaluation to identify red flags and fatal flows

Redesign and update layouts, energy production estimates, EPC cost estimates, and equipment selections

Coordinate with M&A developer to complete necessary RFP response documentation

Design for select projects up to 30% electrical, civil, structural, and mechanical

Project Execution 

Mega

Develop scopes of work and technical contract exhibits.

Seek and evaluate proposals for engineering services.

Manage engineering consultants and EPC contractors to develop project construction drawings and support materials.

Perform technical project due diligence and project engineering design reviews.

Coordinate feedback from internal stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) on design reviews.

Value engineer PV and BESS system designs to maximize reliability and reduce overall project cost.

Technical support during construction including: 

Respond to contractor requests for information (RFIs).

Perform quality assurance (QA)/ quality control (QC) checks in the field.

Develop punchlists.

Support commissioning activities with internal Technology/Commissioning teams and external stakeholders.

Review commissioning reports and analyze system performance.

Support internal Owner’s Engineering team through financing activities.

Support Operations/Asset Management teams to resolve technical issues at operating sites.

Assist Development and Project Management teams with budget development and key financial inputs.

Reporting to the AES CE Manager of Technical Services, the goal of this position is to support, improve, and optimize the AES Clean Energy operational performance of a fleet of renewables across the US by providing technical expertise, troubleshooting and critical process support to substation relays, meters and communications equipment. The Senior Protection Relay and Metering engineer will provide support and troubleshooting to solar, wind and BESS facilities with substation telemetry, relay connectivity and OT projects requiring operations support. The Senior Protection Relay and Metering engineer will interface routinely with field services personnel and serve as the operations department liaison between networking personnel and the operational technology department.

Location: Remote/Hybrid. Preferred Locations Salt Lake City, UT; Louisville, CO; Dayton, OH; Indianapolis, IN; Churubusco, NY, Southern California or Phoenix metro area (Covering turbine assets across the US)

Main Responsibilities:

Primary subject matter expert for AES Clean Energy substation automation controller installations and troubleshooting

Substation meter subject matter expert

Establish and maintain connectivity, access and passwords to all substation and meter sites. Facilitate establishing these connections for new team members.

Provide real-time troubleshooting for emergent events involving substations, transmission lines or collection systems. Assist in educating team members in troubleshooting methods.

Mentor and train team members, BOP and field resources on connecting to relays and meters for the purposes of retrieving and interpreting relay data.

Ensure new sites have meters, relays and event collection configured properly for remote access and event collection

Provide real-time support to sites by collecting events and distributing event data and information to personnel to reduce the return to service time of substations impacted by disturbance events.

Manage the replacement of aging Remote Automation Controllers to minimize disruption to operations.

Participate in deployments of new OT initiatives and provide operations perspective/representation in their rollout.

Evaluate replacement solutions for obsolescent equipment such as PLC controllers or multifunction relays.

Participate in teams for the rollout of new NERC standards requiring telemetry solutions for event collection or electrical data collection.

Provide guidance and feedback to project execution teams on the setup of software protocols for communication of events/data.

Coordinate with reliability and performance engineers any OT/communications improvement technologies for the AESCE renewables fleet.

Share and capitalize on lessons learned and benchmarking from not only AES but other industry leaders.

Monitor new technology innovations in operational technology and substation communications systems and provide recommendations to project design teams to implement where appropriate.

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or equivalent technical field from an accredited college/university and 3-5 years of professional experience in one or more of the following areas: (PLCs,SCADA integration, networking, renewable energy systems, relays, power plant controllers and substation equipment)

Knowledge of condition monitoring systems and their connectivity

Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills related to network communications and SCADA systems

Knowledge of RTAC programming/Structured Text

Fluency with data acquisition systems and SCADA systems

Candidate must be innovative, with strong troubleshooting skills and must be flexible, with the ability to organize, prioritize, execute and follow up on many concurrent duties, as well as adapt quickly to changes in business priorities.

Ability to establish trust through building relationships and demonstration of capabilities.

Strong coaching skills and safety awareness.

Ability to work flexible schedules (late evenings/early mornings) as required

Proficient in the following focus areas; Communication Systems, operational technology systems related to renewables, and condition monitoring systems.

Outstanding interpersonal skills, including an ability to maintain calm and effective exchanges by all parties.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior SCADA Engineer to join our Remote Operational Control Center (ROCC) team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems that monitor and control utility generation processes for our North American AES Clean Energy operations. This is position offers flexibility and the opportunity to work with SCADA technologies in a dynamic and collaborative environment. This is a solid opportunity for an individual to build a future in renewables for themselves and make a positive impact both at AES and globally. 

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Design, configure, and maintain SCADA systems for operational control centers, ensuring reliable and secure data acquisition and process control.

Directly manage the SCADA Process and SCADA Vendor/integrator to meet project requirements and timelines

Monitor system performance, troubleshooting issues, and resolve faults to ensure continuous and efficient operation.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate SCADA systems with other industrial automation platforms and enterprise IT systems.

Work with SCADA Integrators to develop, test, and implement SCADA logic, graphical interfaces, and alarm systems to support operational requirements.

Review internal exhibits, create Scopes of Work (SOW) for SCADA bids and pass directly to vendors as needed. Delineate responsibilities and identify scope gaps. 

Participate in cybersecurity assessments and support best practices to protect SCADA infrastructure from threats.

Provide remote technical support and training to operations staff and end-users.

Document system configurations, procedures, and maintenance activities.

Participate in system upgrades, migrations, and expansion projects as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or equivalent field experience.

5+ years of experience in SCADA engineering, preferably in an operational control center environment.

Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize projects and tasks.

Experience with SCADA platforms such as Bluence, Ignition, Emerson Ovation Green, Rockwell Factory Talk Optix, Wonderware, Siemens WinCC, or similar.

Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC, etc.).

Experience with remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and support tools.

Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices for industrial control systems.

Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote setting and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of networking and IT infrastructure related to SCADA systems.

Experience with cloud-based SCADA solutions and virtualization technologies.

SCADA project management experience.
