India-Chennai

Job Description:

Primary Purpose 

The Director, Government Relations Operations drives the execution of Allison Transmission’s global government relations strategy by providing operational leadership, advanced analytics, and program management across international, federal, and state advocacy efforts. This role partners closely with the Managing Director, Government Relations to advance legislative, regulatory, and political objectives through robust policy analysis, stakeholder engagement, process implementation, financial oversight, and internal alignment. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

Strategic & Operational Leadership 

Support and execute the enterprise-wide government relations strategy under the direction of the Managing Director. 

Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of GR processes, workflows, and performance metrics. 

Provide program and project management leadership across key GR initiatives, cross-functional efforts, and leadership engagements. 

Policy Monitoring & Analytics 

Monitor international, federal, and state legislative and regulatory developments impacting transportation, industrial, defense, energy, and manufacturing sectors. 

Conduct quantitative and qualitative policy analysis, including scenario modeling and impact assessments. 

Prepare executive-level briefings, dashboards, and analytical reports to inform business decisions. 

Stakeholder Engagement & Advocacy Support 

Coordinate outreach and engagement with policymakers, legislative staff, regulatory agencies, and external stakeholders. 

Support strategic engagement with trade associations, coalitions, and global industry forums. 

Strengthen internal stakeholder alignment across business units, legal, finance, and strategy teams. 

Operations, Compliance & Financial Management 

Manage government relations operations, including issue tracking, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, and documentation. 

Oversee the GR budget, financial modeling for advocacy initiatives, forecasting, and variance reporting. 

Administer Political Action Committee (PAC) compliance, reporting, and governance requirements. 

Global Coordination 

Support internationally focused policy monitoring and advocacy, coordinating with global partners and overseas stakeholders. 

Ensure consistency and alignment across global advocacy activities, messaging, and strategic priorities. 

 

Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree required; JD preferred. 

Experience working on congressional staff, in a lobbying environment, or in a public policy role preferred.

7+ years of industry experience preferred. 

Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local lobbying regulations preferred.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex policy issues into clear executive summaries. 

Financial acumen, including modeling, forecasting, and budget oversight. 

 

Experience 

Experience or interest developing, supporting, or executing a legislative or public policy agenda. 

Exposure to transportation, manufacturing, defense, energy, industrial, or trade policy issues. 

Ability to synthesize complex policy information into actionable insights and executive-ready materials. 

Demonstrated experience in stakeholder engagement, coalition management, and advocacy coordination. 

Proven track record of building or improving processes, project management, and operational execution. 

Strong analytical, organizational, and compliance skills. 

High level of proficiency in Microsoft office applications – including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams. 

 

Travel 

Travel required to Washington, DC, and additional domestic and international jurisdictions where Allison Transmission engages in lobbying, coalition activity, or stakeholder outreach.

Excellent oral and written English communication skills.

Data analytics, SAP, SharePoint, AuditBoard, and Microsoft Teams experience helpful.

Ability to travel domestically and occasionally internationally (up to approximately 15-20%)

Experience:

8+ years of internal audit, public accounting, and/or other related industry experience with progressive responsibility, including team supervisory and management.

Demonstrated experience with risk-based audit planning, corporate/operational audits, and IT audits and control testwork.

Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize multiple concurrent tasks.

Proven ability to independently plan audits, analyze results, and write audit reports.

CIA/CPA/CFE/CISA or equivalent certification required

Proficient understanding of and experience with internal controls and audit documentation.

This position combines the core commercial and strategic responsibilities of a Commodity Manager along with project management skills required to support assigned direct material contracting for Electronics and Complex Electrical Assemblies. The Commodity Manager develops and manages working relationships with both internal stakeholders and suppliers of materials and services. Job Description:

Primary Purpose of Role

The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) is accountable for achieving the regional sales and profitability objectives. This role will pursue growth in Off Highway’s industrial business within the regional geography. Candidates for this position must be located near major industrial target city (Portland, San Francisco, Los Angles, phoenix, Salt Lake City) and open to frequent travel to customers in the region and Off Highway facilities.

Key Responsibilities

Provides leadership for Off Highway’s internal and external customers in all assigned tasks, while always upholding Off Highway’s core values.

Achieve the region’s revenue and profitability plan for Off Highway Industrial business. Establish an environment and foundation for sustainable future sales growth. Sells and teaches others how to sell the Off Highway value proposition to Off Highway’s valued customers.

Direct the selling activities within the region, inclusive of resource deployment and customer interactions. Prioritizes Off Highway resources effectively and in accordance with Off Highway’s corporate objectives.

Efficiently manages Off Highway’s distributor relationships. Works in conjunction with the territory development and key account teams to ensure growth in defined key account segments.

Responsible for the region’s forecasting and sales tracking requirements in a timely and defined manner.

Sets strategic vision for the region; develops and adheres to the approved business plan; and, accomplishes the growth initiatives that have been established in Off Highway’s annual budget process.

Evaluates market trends and gathers competitive information, identifies trends that can affect current and future growth of regional sales and profitability. 

Special projects as assigned.

Ability to travel as required to accomplish the objectives and requirements of the territory.

Be willing to and skilled in prospecting for new projects and customer opportunities.

Competencies 

Languages – English is mandatory; other languages are preferred.

Strong technical knowledge and hands on experience on Off Highway products.

Knowledge of failure modes analysis (what failed and why). Strong 8D discipline and basic RED X knowledge.

Strong computer skills. High computer’s skills in Microsoft & internet; Off Highway systems is an advantage.

High verbal and written communication skills (Face to face, Phone & e-mail).

Strong process and teaming skills as this position involves a great deal of interaction with Leadership, Service Centers, and Customers. Must be self-starter and able to work towards department goals with minimal supervision.

Qualifications and Experience 

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is preferred. Industry experience of three to five years in field sales will also be considered. Preference given for direct experience with Industrial customers in stationary applications in Power Transmission and Gear Reducer engineering and or sales.

Track record of growing territory sales and overcoming customer objections.

Ability to evaluate a sales territory, develop a territory roadmap and a desire to pursue new customer interactions. Be comfortable engaging with customers and prospects by telephone and online as needed.

Accountable with a sense of curiosity towards the unknown.

Working knowledge of the Stationary Industrial Market, Gear Reducer and Power Transmission Industry. (F Brevini product knowledge preferred)

Record of individual and TEAM achievements in prior sales positions.

Strong negotiating skills. Formal sales training courses a plus.

Oversee accounts receivable activity, escalating and resolving customer payment issues.

Strong interpersonal skills, Oral, written, telephone and presentation skills.

Ability to learn and retain product specific information and utilize to position the features and benefits to customers’ needs.

Computer literate with knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, Microsoft BI, and CRM system Salesforce.com.

Travel

Ability to travel (approx. 50% of time, mostly in territory)

Job Description:

Primary Purpose of Role: 

The Manufacturing Services Manager is accountable to lead a team of salaried and hourly technical staff in support of plant operations. A champion of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), this role is responsible for managing TPM initiatives and implementing the Allison Operational Excellence through exceptional collaboration, leadership, and guidance. This role provides input and support to overall plant strategy such as capital planning projects, workforce planning, annual budget & forecasting activities, and employee development.

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership / Managerial responsibilities:

Directly manage a team of Supervisors, Maintenance Planners, and Maintenance/Reliability Engineers with indirect oversight of 40+ hourly employees.

Responsible for full employee life cycle including selection, training, development, employee relations, and performance management.

Responsible for performance management, training and development of team members aligned with career ambitions and areas of opportunity to improve, including annual performance reviews and Individual Development Plans (IDPs).

Serve as a leader, trainer, and coach of Lean Manufacturing and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) principles, which includes Operator Autonomous Maintenance execution and continuous improvement.

Leads team and implements departmental objectives aligned with plant & company objectives through day-to-day management, annual performance reviews, and corrective actions.

Manages and provides guidance to team on utilization of problem-solving tools such as 4Ds and 8Ds to implement permanent corrective actions.

Create, develop, and sustain a can-do climate and high levels of frequent communication, cooperation, rewards and recognition, training, and mutual support among departments.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement the Allison Operational Excellence system with focus on maintenance pillars such as good equipment performance, prevent equipment failure, repair equipment quickly and prevent recurrence.

As a leader in the organization, you will provide a physical presence in the workplace to lead and promote a culture of accountability and teamwork.

Ensures Allison Transmission policies and procedures are adhered to and executed in area of responsibility.

Union relationship management: 

Engagement with shop committee

Grievance management

Adherence to Collective Bargaining Agreement

Provide input and support the Allison Apprenticeship Committee and Plant Maintenance Committee

Shopfloor Accountability: 

Drive performance across area of responsibility aligned with overall plant objectives and strategy.

Facilitate floor operations to meet safety, quality, production cost, and schedule requirements through the utilization of established manufacturing processes and methods.

Supports internal customers with care and urgency in managing machine down time to support production demands.

Develop and implement preventive, predictive, and scheduled maintenance programs to effectively reduce emergency maintenance downtime and drive pro-active results.

Lead cross-functional teams focused on Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and Units per Hour (UPH) continuous improvement activities in support of the Allison Operational Excellence system with emphasis on maintenance / machine pillars.

Leads Workplace Organization (WO) initiatives across plant operations.

Lead improvement across plant through production performance, machine availability and quality.

Monitor and provide input on spare parts inventory levels.

Strategic / Forward Looking Responsibilities:

Provide input to company budget and forecast processes, managing budget in area of responsibility.

Develop and manage continuous improvement plans with defined action items, resource allocation, and planned timing.

Support workforce planning activities based on company strategy and plant volumes to identify resource needs and training gaps.

Collaborates cross-functionally in support of capital planning.

Work with support teams to develop annual budget, optimize resources, and ensure ongoing execution of department plans.

Key Performance Measures:

Safety

Quality

Cost

Productivity

Responsiveness

Competencies and Behaviors:

Required:

Exceptional leadership, communication and interpersonal skills to leverage the power of teamwork effectively with others at all levels of the organization and cross-functional to motivate employees and elicit work output.

Ability to adapt to changes in responsibility based on business needs.

High level of analytical ability for solving complex problems, using creative thinking to find and implement solutions / improvements.

Skilled in managing challenges and conflicts as they arise in alignment with Allison’s values and core competencies.

Makes decisions that positively impact the current and future state of the business.

Continuous improvement mindset improving overall team performance to achieve plant and company objectives.

Expertise in manufacturing standards and metrics (e.g., KPIs) for safety, quality, production, labor and material variances, lean manufacturing, and employee relations and retention.

Strong organizational, planning and time management skills.

Strong attention to detail

Comfortable presenting at direct report, peer, and senior leadership level

Demonstrated ability in forecasting, budgeting, and P&L management.

Strong technical aptitude to support manufacturing environment (assembly operations, machining operations)

Strong computer skills (Microsoft tools, Power BI, Workday, Maximo)

Strong understanding of CNC, PLC controls and Robotics.

Ability to interpret blueprints and engineering drawings.

Strong understanding of and ability to train on mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic concepts.

Qualifications:

Required:

Associates degree in Maintenance or related technical field, or Bachelors degree in Engineering or related technical program

Experience:

Required:

10+ years’ experience in maintenance/facilities role including 5+ years’ experience leading a team of maintenance/facilities staff in manufacturing environment.

Experience building, developing, engaging, and overseeing high-performing manufacturing teams, with a track record of questioning behavioral norms and driving cultural change.

Experience in applying Lean manufacturing concepts to reduce cost and improve productivity; experience developing and organizing continuous improvement programs; demonstrated track record of driving positive change.

Preferred:

Experience in Union environment, ideally leading a team of Union employees

Hands-on experience as an industrial tradesman, service mechanic/engineer or maintenance engineer.

Manages lower-level supervisors, managers, or team of professional/technical employees.

Occasionally interacts with senior leadership team. Frequently interacts with peers of the same level or lower. Interactions generally within the same function but some cross function interactions.

Greater size, impact, and/or technical complexity of the activities managed than Manager level.

Manages professional employees or supervises large complex operations/teams.

Adapts departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges.

Areas of responsibility are typically unique within the department or function.

Accountable for the performance and results of a team within own discipline or function; conducts performance reviews and recommends pay actions.

Erroneous decisions will result in critical delay(s) in schedules and/or unit operations and may jeopardize overall business activities

Job Description:

Position Overview:

A Machinist demonstrates these competencies: Successfully commits him/herself and completes all training requirements to continuously improve his/her skills. Demonstrates independent decision-making skills on day to day production tasks that steadfastly pushes self and others for results. Prepared and receptive mind that looks toward the broadest possible view of an issue/challenge. Thrives in a fast-paced environment that enjoys hard work. Adds value to the team by immersing him/herself in challenges and comes up with new and unique ideas for solutions. A Machinist exhibits these behaviors: The Machinist is responsible for daily verification and maintenance of manufacturing equipment and ensures appropriate records are updated/maintained. Inspects, completes and coordinates maintenance of manufacturing equipment which may include mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, or pneumatic systems. Plans, coordinates and performs installation, setups of machinery. Tests and adjusts as needed. Diagnoses and repairs malfunctioning equipment. Recommends and implements process improvements. Updates required documentation including maintenance and repair logs. Reads and interprets equipment manuals and work orders to perform required maintenance and service. Machinist will set up and operate conventional, special purpose and computer numerical control machines and machining centers to machine metal parts by performing the following tasks and responsibilities.

Essential Duties:

Implement sequences of operations and machine setup requirements.

Operate CNC gear machines, including setup, adjustments, operating numeric control and computer numeric controlled turning and machining centers.

Could perform a variety of operations such as turning, boring, drilling, milling, reaming, taping, threading, etc. to produce close-tolerance parts.

Setup, adjust, and operate a variety of gear hobbing, shaping, grinding, and sawing machines producing close tolerance gears, splines, and pinions.

Study blueprints, sketches, drawings, manuals, specifications, or sample part to determine dimensions and tolerances of finished work-piece, sequences of operations, and setup requirements.

Select, align and secure holding fixtures, cutting tools, attachments, accessories, and materials on machines such as mills, lathes, jig borers, grinders and shapers to perform precision machining operations.

Calculate, set and monitor controls to regulate machining factors such as speed, feed, coolant flow, and depth and angle of cut, or enter commands to retrieve, input, or edit computerized machine control media.

Start and observe machine operation to detect malfunctions or out-of-tolerance machining and adjusts machine controls or control media as required.

Maintain equipment by performing routine maintenance on equipment. familiar with and can operate controls from multiple manufactures. Add coolant and oil when needed. Keep chips off ways and jaws.

Maintain a clean and safe workspace.

Job Description:

Primary Purpose of Role

Allison Off Highway Lugoff SC is a warehouse/distribution operation that primarily receives, picks, packs and ships automotive parts. Our parts weigh anywhere from ounces to several hundred pounds. A warehouse associate will have to lift numerous parts daily while receiving, picking, and packing the work orders.

Key Responsibilities

The primary function of a warehouse associate is to check in, separate and put away inbound product as well as pick, pack, ship outbound orders and move material within the warehouse. A warehouse associate must be able to read and follow a work order. A forklift or other lifting device is used to put away received product, pick orders, load shipments, and consolidate product. While there will be primary tasks to be performed based on work schedule and training, the warehouse associate position includes the possibility of performing any of the job functions in the distribution center including all inbound and outbound operations, material handling, and housekeeping. It is possible to perform multiple job functions during the same work shift. As a result, cross training in different job functions is necessary in this position. Warehouse associates are required to clean workstations, sweep floors and perform other housekeeping duties throughout the shift.

Essential Functions of the Job

Ability to lift 25 pounds consistently and 75 pounds occasionally

Overhead lifting

Stooping/Bending to floor level

Reaching and lifting

Twisting left/right

Walking and standing up to 12 hours

Drive a forklift throughout the day

Full range of motion involving neck movements

Full range of motion with wrists

Ability to read and write

Ability to use calculator for accurate counts

Ability to use radio frequency equipment (barcode scanners and tablets) to perform warehouse functions

Maintain excellent housekeeping

Follow verbal and written instructions

Ability to work as a team player

Additional duties may be required to support the business and will be directed by the supervisor.

Qualifications and Experience

High School diploma preferred

1-3 years’ experience in distribution environment

Detail-oriented

Excellent attendance, safety, accuracy, and productivity

Job Description:

Primary Purpose of Role:

The Environmental Engineer performs professional engineering work to protect or improve air, land and water resources in order to provide a clean and healthful environment utilizing a robust Environmental Management System. This work requires a professional knowledge of the principles, methods and techniques of engineering concerned with facilities and systems for controlling pollution and protecting quality of resources and the environment. An understanding and the ability to utilize pertinent aspects of chemistry, biological sciences and public health that pertain to the control or elimination of pollutants are also major functions. Strong regulatory knowledge of federal, state and local laws is a must. Join a group of Environmental Engineers that are responsible developing and sustaining proactive management systems, checks and balances, and other necessary systems to ensure effective environmental compliance at the plant and facilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Provide oversight and ensures regulatory compliance of applicable regulatory requirements. Focus area is on air compliance, air compliance related activities, air emission reduction and alternative sustainable usage activities. 

Access, research, interpret and effectively communicate environmental regulations and requirements.

Additional knowledge and oversight with site and projects, RCRA, CAA, NPDES, CWA, POTW, SARA, TSCA, DOT and ISO14001 Management Systems.

Develop and maintain detailed records of all environmental activities for the facility. Organize and maintain an accurate filing system and accessible online database. Update pertinent charts and graphs of data in a timely manner.

Provide environmental training and other communication, as necessary, to personnel at all levels and functions of the organizations. May attend production meetings to deliver environmental training or follow up. May need to travel to satellite plants to deliver training as needed.

Track key compliance metrics and implement systems to improve performance within the organization. Identify ways to reduce air emissions, with an emphasis on pollution prevention.

Routinely communicate with state and federal regulatory agencies to meet reporting requirements as needed.

Complete HAZWOPER training and perform necessary environmental clean ups to releases and events at the facility.

Develop, implement, and test plans to minimize environmental risks (e.g. spill plans, RCRA contingency plans, SPCC, HAZWOPER, SWPPP, etc.)

Effectively track regulatory and corporate due dates for reporting, permit renewals, etc. and meet deadlines with sufficient time to facilitate review and approval by management and the timely submission of information.

Confirm and complete all ISO 14001 tasks as assigned. (e.g. monthly air compliance inspections throughout the production facility and outside grounds as well as frequent follow up within the facility on non-conforming air management practices).

Performs routine site inspections of areas, work sites contractors, all levels of employees and other environmental activities. Requirement to document all non-conformances and track corrective action to completion.

Key Performance Measures:

Safety

Quality

Cost

Productivity

Responsiveness

Competencies:

Knowledgeable of environmental regulations including, CAA, Title V Air Permitting, and other air compliance related regulations.

High level of proficiency with Microsoft programs (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, Power Apps, Power BI).

Effectively communicate and interact with all levels of personnel. 

Competent technical writing experience. 

Ability to make evidence-based deductions.

Understanding of environmental analytical methods and procedures required.

Highly focused, detail oriented, and self-motivated.

Required to effectively interact with other department managers, and regulatory officials in a manner that sets a positive image for the Company.

Qualifications:

Required:

Bachelors degree in Environmental Engineering or related field

Preferred:

CHMM or equivalent certification

Current on HAZWOPER training (Operations Level).

Experience:

Required:

3+ years’ experience in Environmental Engineer or closely related role

Preferred:

5+ years’ experience in Environmental Engineer or closely related role

Experience working with AutoCAD, MAXIMO, Ariba, and SAP.

Experience working with Safety Data Sheets and Chemical Product Data Sheets and interpreting relevant chemical and environmental data from the information provided.

Experience in Air Permitting and Reporting.

Job Description:

As a Senior Staff Gear Engineer for Allison Transmission Gear Systems team, you will be responsible for the gear design and development associated with new transmissions and transmission variants, while also providing directly support to problem resolution and cost optimization efforts for existing product lines across all end markets. In this role, you will provide specialized expertise in gear design and analysis, contributing to engineering decisions related to performance, manufacturability, and reliability of gear systems.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the Center of Expertise (COE) for gear design and analysis, with a strong system-level understanding of interactions with adjacent mechanical components such as shafts, housings, bearings, splines, and carriers

Foster effective collaboration within the team, demonstrating technical expertise and mentoring the success and growth of others

Conduct CAE system level modeling and simulation of complete transmissions to evaluate durability, performance, and efficiency 

Support DFMEA, PFMEA and BP activities to guide product design; including either generation of new or modification of existing documents

Perform engineering calculations: component loading, stress, and life calculations for general sizing efforts 

Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure design intend in maintained during all design phases (from Concept Validation to Production) 

Execute R&D activities related to Gear Systems in support of Technology Information Lifecycle and new gear technology/materials/processes

Contribute to the development of internal capabilities by mentoring engineers and supporting the creation of tools, guidelines, and design/analysis standards that advance gear design and analysis practices across the organization

Utilizes strong communication and presentation skills to engage effectively with stakeholders, ensuring customer needs are understood and addressed through practical and mutually beneficial engineering solutions

Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation to ensure traceability, support engineering decisions, and enable knowledge retention

Stay current with industry advancements in gear design, analysis, manufacturing techniques, post-processing treatments, and materials to inform and enhance engineering best practices

Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering

Master’s degree in related Engineering field, preferred

Excellent oral and written (e.g. presentations) communication skills

Demonstrated history of developing solutions to complex technical challenges

Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple different programs simultaneously

15+ years of engineering experience in gear systems design analysis and manufacturing

Strong problem solving techniques including but not limited to; Red X, Kepner Tregoe, 8D, Six Sigma, Fault Tree Analysis

5+ years of experience modelling in SMT Masta, Romax or KISSsoft or comparable, preferred

Proficient on gear manufacturing processes, and heat treatments

Working knowledge of tribology, preferred 

Familiar with 3D CAD tools (preferably Siemens NX) and GD&T 

Ability to read, interpret and create detail drawings and blueprints

This role is located in Indianapolis, IN

Lead media & public relations to manage our enterprise public image, enhance visibility and elevate brand reputation globally; align with global enterprise strategy, strategic imperatives, culture & values. Understand the target audiences and develop compelling, positive and memorable communications through exceptional storytelling and networking skills. 

Key Responsibilities:

Media Strategy, Planning & Processes – Develop and drive media relations strategies across all global markets; develop and update the annual media & PR calendar and own global media relations process and in/outsourcing policy.

Relationship & Agency Management - Work closely with and be central point of contact for Media and Public Relations for: C-level Executive and Functional Leadership Global & regional teams: IR Relations (investors), Government Relations (government), HR / Internal Communications (employees, students), MS&S (customers), SCM (suppliers), Branding & Content, Marketing & Digital Communications Tier-one media, journalists, and influencers for all end markets & segments External Global PR Agencies manage and coordinate the network to ensure consistent and effective execution of PR activities in all regions. External customers: OEMs, Distributor Managed OEMs (DOEMs), distributor partners, end users / fleet.

Content & Story Development 
Prepare and/or orchestrate the creation and distribution of corporate and local press releases and spokesperson briefings.
Build impactful, memorable, positive stories which touch the hearts and minds (emotion); stories customized to resonate with all different key stakeholders, cultures and local media landscapes: from C-level executives, investors and bankers, media & journalists, purchasers, to OEMs, distributors, dealers, fleet managers. From cultures in North America, South America, Europe, Middle East & Africa to Asia Pacific.

Executive Visibility & Press Conferences - Deliver executive visibility programs (interviews, panels), leadership talking points and organize and manage press conferences globally

Media Training & Spokesperson - serve as the official voice of the company to the public and media; train or enable training (e.g. through 3rd party) for authorized corporate leaders to speak to media and in public. 

Crisis & Issues Response - Shape and deliver crisis communications with external parties and issues response, ensuring a coordinated and timely response. 

Measure Impact – Track and analyze media coverage to gauge enterprise campaign effectiveness and reputation impact (Share of Voice, quality of coverage, sentiment analysis, PR Value etc.)

Track Global Media Coverage & Reach (through media monitoring software, report out by our PR /PAN agency network)

Geographical & End Markets Presence: The number of media mentions and their spread across different regions or countries and different market segments we operate in (On-highway, Off-highway, Defense).

Leveraging the Power of Teamwork

Influence and lead others to better outcomes through inclusion and involvement.

Bring people together and build bridges to connect people for common cause Allison and the community.

As part of Allison’s Technical Assistance Center (TAC), the Technical Service Representative (TSR) assists professionally trained, and Allison certified technicians in the field with technical inquiries and diagnostic assistance. The TSR is also responsible for assisting the Allison end-user by answering basic operational questions and guiding them to the authorized Allison repair locations if they need service. The TSR works with a cross-functional team comprised of members from Service Engineering, the Customer Support Team, and the Warranty Department. Receive calls from Allison Transmission distributor and dealer representatives regarding transmission concerns

Advise distributor representatives of recommendations made 

Perform follow ups on existing cases and close cases as appropriate 

Identifying customers’ needs and complaints, clarify information, research every issue, and provide solutions 

Collaborate with other Allison Departments as necessary 

File and maintain all records and documentation in accordance with corporate retention policies. 

Receive calls from End-Users when requested to fill in for Customer Service Representatives and assist in providing them general information 

Other duties as assigned 

Qualifications / Requirements:

High school diploma or equivalent preferred 

Specialized training and experience in the diagnosis/troubleshooting of major components (engines, transmissions, differentials), OEM training courses and ASE Certification.

1-3 years of practical experience with vehicle maintenance 

Strong Phone and Verbal Communication along with active Listening 

Mechanically inclined and possess a strong understanding of vehicle maintenance and repair 

Analytical thinking/Problem solving 

Previous customer service experience 

Demonstrates excellent written communication

Good understanding of Microsoft Office

Job Description
The Vended Application Expert provides expertise across all major functions in their area(s) of the business and delivers product features utilizing vended software, particularly ERP applications, by applying knowledge of the application’s functionality and client business processes. The role creates technical and process designs and configures vendor software for the highly complex new or existing enterprise-wide and business-unit applications and maintenance efforts. The VAA Expert knows vendor feature roadmaps and capabilities and leverages developer groups and support processes to gain insight and provide direction.

The Vended Application Expert is responsible for implementing, configuring, and operating the applications and platforms that support Allstate’s engineering and business teams. This role owns the lifecycle of these systems, ensuring they are integrated effectively, secured properly, and maintained to meet enterprise standards and customer needs.

They work closely with engineering teams to support reliable operations, streamline workflows, and improve how applications interact with Allstate’s cloud platforms. They handle operational tasks, troubleshoot issues, coordinate enhancements, and ensure SLAs are consistently met. They also contribute to building and improving the tools and processes that enable teams to use these applications efficiently.

The Vended Application Expert demonstrates strong engineering practices, drives automation and reliability improvements, and helps elevate the overall efficiency of the systems they manage. They play a key role in ensuring the applications remain stable, compliant, and aligned with Allstate’s technology strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Designs, builds, manages, and operates the infrastructure and configuration of the platform infrastructure and application environments with a focus on automation and infrastructure as code.

Leads a team in engineering practices around test driven and continuous delivery of infrastructure.

Designs, builds, manages, and operates the continuous delivery framework and tools, manages, and automates the lifecycle of the different platform components.

Designs, builds, manages, and operates the infrastructure as a service layer (hosted and cloud-based platforms) that supports the different platform services.

Develops comprehensive monitoring solutions to provide full visibility to the different platform components using tools and services like Datadog, New Relic, Azure Monitor, and other similar tools.

Develops a log analytics solution to provide logging-as-a-service to hosted applications based on open-source solutions.

Integrates different components and develop new services with a focus on open source to allow a minimal friction developer interaction with the platform and application services.

Evaluates performance trends and expected changes in demand and capacity; and establish the appropriate scalability plans.

Identifies and troubleshoots any availability and performance issues at multiple layers of deployment, from hardware, operating environment, network and application.

Recommends and maintains technology related policies and procedures.

Experience

7 or more years of experience (Preferred).

In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Technical Skills

Deep level of understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and its relationship between Azure and M365.

Deep level of understanding of Azure Management Groups and Policy.

Deep level of understanding of Azure Regions, Availability Zones, VNets, Private Endpoints and Express Route.

Minimum 5 years’ experience with Azure Cloud Services.

Experience with GCP services such as Compute, IAM, Networking, and image management.

Functional Skills

Experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, and Application Knowledge.

Experience in testing and programming.

Able to mentor team members on the various engineering practices including extreme programming, product mindset, cloud/as-a-service approach, and infrastructure as code.

Solid background in Software Development / Projects and building Cloud (Azure) Solutions.

Willingness and competence in producing necessary changes in our infrastructure and processes.

Ability to work in an Extreme Programming environment and must be willing to work in a paired programming/engineering model.

Able to facilitate diverse teams, multi-task, and work under pressure to meet aggressive schedule targets.

Able to work effectively across organizational and geographical boundaries.

Identify creative solutions for technical support issues.

Able to communicate effectively across groups of diverse backgrounds.

Ability to present ideas and solutions with clarity to various levels.

Job Description
A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job! As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved. 

In this role, candidates must demonstrate a high level of adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced and continuously evolving environment. Success requires the ability to manage multiple, diverse venues simultaneously, each with its own unique operational demands and stakeholder expectations.

As the claim owner, you are the primary point of contact for the customer for their claim. While others—such as field adjusters or repair shops—may assist with the claim, the insured will look to you for guidance throughout the process. 
 
Excellent customer service is essential. For many customers, this may be their first experience filing a claim. It's your responsibility to support them through what can be a stressful situation by providing clear communication and empathetic guidance. 

Additionally, the role involves close collaboration with internal partners to assess and drive value across initiatives. This cross-functional engagement is key to aligning strategic goals and delivering impactful outcomes.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific or Mountain time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico. 

The work schedule varies depending on your local time zone: 

Pacific Time Zone: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm PST

Mountain Time Zones: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM MST

Allstate Benefits 

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience: 

The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and text with customers and others to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a

specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder –you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

What You Need: 

A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.

A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.

Appropriate work surface and seating.

What Allstate Provides:

A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitor, headset, keyboard, mouse).

Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset a portion of your internet costs.

Preferred Qualifications:

Minimum 2 years' experience in bodily injury claims handling or a related field.

Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.

Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.

Knowledge of insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Notice of Licensing Requirement 

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign-on Bonus: You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.*

**Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Bernstein Private Wealth Management is a premier investment management firm advising high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients. As an industry leader, we put people first and pride ourselves on selecting and developing high caliber talent. 

Bernstein Private Wealth Associates are client service professionals who exhibit drive, ambition, and exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, and who, in collaboration with Financial Advisors, help propel the growth of our Private Wealth Management Platform. This is an exciting and challenging opportunity to partner with Advisors to provide asset allocation recommendations, capital markets positioning, portfolio analytics, and wealth and legacy planning for high-net-worth individuals and families.

 

An Associate will: 

Collaborate and network with senior professionals throughout the firm to fuel career success

Partner with Financial Advisors to build their business and provide service and support functions such as portfolio analysis, account creation and maintenance, and client/prospect meeting preparation

Build relationships with clients and prospective clients to understand and support all aspects of their servicing needs

Strive to provide a world-class level of customer service and support

Our Comprehensive Development Program

Associates will participate in a robust and comprehensive training program – The Associate Development Program (ADP). After years of heavy financial investment and input from industry leaders, ADP is a one-of-a-kind opportunity. The Program is designed to build a foundation of investment knowledge and develop the quantitative and qualitative skills needed to achieve long-term stability and success, regardless of your incoming background.

Components of the Associate Development Program (ADP) Include:

In-depth industry training on proprietary investments, services, policies and procedures

Advanced training on trusts & estates, wealth planning, investment management philosophies, and financial management strategies

A focus on client service excellence, partnership and sales training in order to provide an exceptional client experience

Behavioral training geared toward the development of communication, leadership, and other professional skills

Career management, one-on-one coaching, and specialized skills training to achieve success beyond the Associate role
 

Associates have a myriad of opportunities to continue their career with us as a client service professional or in areas including Leadership, Wealth Strategies, Investment Strategies, and building their own business as an Advisor. We take all of our Associates' development seriously, and we focus on understanding each individual’s strengths and aspirations, personalizing a roadmap with the success of each team member in mind. As Associates progress in the role, and as milestones are achieved and core competencies are exhibited (typically over the course of ~3 years), we celebrate the opportunity to advance team members on to other exciting opportunities at Bernstein Private Wealth Management.

Job Qualifications

We Are Seeking:

People who possess strong analytical and communication skills (both written and verbal) and an ability to build relationships

Accomplished team players who thrive in a rigorous and challenging environment

Individuals who are client-focused and detail-oriented with a strong ability to multi-task and work under pressure in a fast-paced atmosphere

Individuals who have a bachelor's degree with excellence in academics and strong leadership experience

Proficiency in Word and Excel are required

Desired Qualifications

1-2 years client service experience, financial services industry experience a plus

The Firm will sponsor required series exams, including SIE, Series 7, and Series 63, but candidates with licenses are a plus

Bernstein Private Wealth Management advises high-net-worth clients on planning for—and living with—the complexities that come with wealth. We specialize in addressing challenges that extend well beyond wealth management by offering a vast network of resources customized to clients’ values and needs.

Bernstein is distinguished among major wealth managers by its holistic approach, flexible process, innovative research, sophisticated modeling, and cutting-edge investment solutions. This is a regular full-time management position in which the candidate will be reporting directly to the AES team lead for the wind facility. The ideal candidate must have strong leadership ability, including the ability to develop, educate, and ensure the safety of others. The position requires excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills. The position will require a willingness to work extra and/or irregular work hours and/or shift schedules as needed.

This position will support maintenance and site strategy by managing, tracking, and reporting site maintenance, work schedules, turbine and field repairs, and other work as required. Will be responsible for project capability, process efficiency, cost efficiency, project availability, quality standards, and any contractual obligations of the project or work area. Will analyze project performance and make recommendations to improve reliability, efficiency, and, ultimately, the project's financial performance. This position will be responsible for site safety, environmental training, and their respective programs.

This role commutes to the wind farm at West Camp Wind, Arizona, each week. The closest towns are Heber or Holbrook, AZ. You are expected to work on-site five days per week, 7 am – 3 pm, including emergency on-call. The work hours may vary if travel to a different location is needed.

A company vehicle and AES credit card will be provided.

As part of the driving requirements for this position, you must have a valid driver's license within the USA and be able to pass a background check.

Candidates must have advanced technical education or training with a minimum of five (5) years experience in plant maintenance, operations, or any other technical field or a high school diploma with a minimum of 5-8 years experience in maintenance/operations. The ideal candidate should have experience with wind turbines and systems, or other is acceptable.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

Perform (or cause to be performed) site maintenance, including without limitation:

Be responsible for all operating activities; understand and ensure compliance with Vestas Full-Service agreement.

Plan and manage contractor work BOP and turbine repair

Road maintenance and snow removal, inspect project roads.

Substation and O&M yard, clean debris, and adequate snow removal to permit access and work.

Check after contractor WTG access for gate closures to avoid livestock issues.

Manage O&M building janitorial tasks, including trash removal and cleanliness.

Engage/monitor workers employed at the site for seasonal tasks. Manage workload. Develop a list of appropriate tasks to be addressed by temporary labor.

Attend daily POD meetings and monitor OEM work on site.

Inspections (regular basis) including but not limited to:

Substations month inspections and corrective work 

Inspect WTG locations after OEM work to ensure no extension of limits of disturbance (vehicles stay on roads).

Gates, locks, and signage.

WTG gravel rings and access roads for deterioration and drainage issues.

Junction box, locks, and arc flash stickers.

SPCC monthly/quarterly checks of crane pads, access roads, gravel rings, ladder foundations, and anchor bolt covers.

Weed control (WTG gravel rings, substation, O&M building, emergency shelter).

Annual T-line vegetation inspection (photos/progress email/reports).

Exercise care, custody, and control of AES Clean Energy equipment and facilities.

Desired Skills, Expertise, and Competencies:

5 years’ Experience in Plant maintenance, operations, or other related technical fields. Experience in Wind Generation is a plus; experience with Vestas turbines is a significant advantage.

O & M management skills

Understanding general workplace safety and the ability to follow safety standards and help the company improve upon the standards in place.

Ability to excel in a collaborative, cross-functional, and geographically diverse organization.

Excellent hands-on abilities with strong technical skills

Ability to read, write, and understand English

Knowledge of applicable safety and environmental regulations

Demonstrates proactive enthusiasm for solving problems and adding value to the company.

Ability to establish and maintain a positive and professional working relationship with all individuals

Communicates openly and honestly and does not engage in gossip.

Models professional behaviors of conduct and etiquette.

Is a strong team player and willing to assist others when necessary and appropriate tasks.

Education/Experience:

Possess a high school diploma or GED.

Advanced technical education or training

Equipment operator preferred

NERC 

NFPA 70E

High voltage training

Working Conditions:

Outdoor work at wind power plants includes windy, dusty, high heat and snow and severe winter conditions.

Driver’s License required.

Requires standing, sitting, walking, kneeling, twisting, climbing stairs and ladders, and entering plant equipment to access, inspect, or collect data on plant equipment

Requires wearing personal protective safety equipment (respirators, safety glasses, hard hat, appropriate footwear, ear plugs, etc.)

May be required to work around rotating and energized equipment, hazardous materials, and chemicals.

Occasionally requires lifting as appropriate to perform duties and responsibilities.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Work overtime and non-standard working hours as required.

Occasional travel

Compensation:

Commensurate with experience; competitive.

Job Description

As a Senior Analyst on the Investment Performance team, you will serve a critical function in advancing initiatives within the broker dealer's Advice & Wealth Management (AWM) segment, specifically those related to investment performance reporting. Responsibilities include conducting research, defining and documenting business requirements, and providing analytical and reporting support. Additionally, you will contribute to the development and ongoing maintenance of the infrastructure necessary to sustain and enhance performance reporting capabilities across the AWM segment of Ameriprise Financial.

Key Responsibilities

In collaboration with other business units (e.g. products, technology, legal, compliance, marketing, training, field implementation, etc.) and vendors, participate in the execution of projects aimed at developing investment products, ensuring compliance, enhancing the quality of the performance data, and improving the front-end experience

Provide data quality oversight, escalation support, process and procedure development, and back-up support to “business and usual” performance reporting operational tasks. 

Maintain or supervise control-related testing across the various performance tools and processes to ensure a single, cohesive approach to testing/audit protocols of reporting mechanisms and underlying data

In collaboration with other business units, participate in the performance verification compliance process for third-party investment manager performance information on the Advisory Platform

Help maintain business ownership of the performance reporting tools utilized for both client performance reporting and product performance reporting for the Advisory Platform

The team is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN. Candidates may also sit in the Charlotte, NC office, with regular virtual collaboration via Microsoft Teams.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in the financial services industry

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

Investment performance measurement, analysis, and reporting experience in a financial services organization (broker/dealer preferred)

Knowledge in investment concepts, practices, procedures, management operations and tools

Experience with both account level performance and product level composite performance.

Conceptual and practical understanding of money-weighted and time-weighted return methodologies, performance characteristic metrics (e.g. alpha, beta), asset allocation, and benchmarking.

Experience working with performance measurement and portfolio accounting systems (e.g., Pershing X (fka Albridge), First Rate, InvestCloud (aka APL), Informa Profile Producer, Envestnet, Morningstar Direct, & FactSet)

Certificate in Investment Performance (CIPM) and/or Charted Financial Analyst (CFA) designation, or progress towards

Understanding of Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) and ability to apply the standards to performance calculations and representations

Knowledge of practices and procedures of retail-oriented investment products and financial planning

Strong communications skills, both oral and written, to interact with team, business partners, advisors, senior management and vendors

Ability to effectively and efficiently multi-task between different projects and recurring tasks

Ability to execute on small to large scale projects with limited supervision

Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships with vendors and across the organization

Strong leadership skills to effectively guide junior colleagues. This is a leadership role. While it does not include direct people management, the selected candidate will lead through influence, collaboration, and subject matter-expertise

Ability to stay current with regulatory requirements and best practices

Job Description

Columbia Threadneedle Investments is seeking a Senior Director, Advisor Consulting to join our Advisor Consulting & Development team. This highly visible, client facing role plays a critical part in shaping and delivering the insights, education, and strategic guidance that help financial advisors better serve their clients and grow their practices.
You will serve as a thought leader and subject matter expert on financial planning topics. Working closely with advisors, wealth management home offices, sales partners, and internal business stakeholders, you will help define program priorities, craft impactful content, and deliver actionable ideas that drive advisor success.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify key industry trends and emerging issues impacting financial advisors, including financial wellness and holistic planning strategies.
• Shape and refine strategic focus areas for the Advisor Consulting & Development program—balancing short term advisor needs with long term industry dynamics.
• Deliver compelling presentations, keynote sessions, workshops, and one on one consulting to financial advisors across multiple channels.
• Partner with Sales, National Accounts, and Marketing to align messaging, content, and go to market strategies.
• Develop and promote actionable content, thought leadership, and messaging frameworks.
• Train internal teams on program themes, insights, and delivery best practices.
• Represent Columbia Threadneedle at conferences, client events, and industry forums as a subject matter expert.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree.
• 10–15 years of financial services experience, ideally within asset management or wealth management.
• Experience working directly with financial advisors and/or clients.
• Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills.
• Proven ability to collaborate and influence across internal and external stakeholder groups.
• Ability to translate complex financial planning topics into clear, practical guidance.
• Experience writing thought leadership or developing high impact presentation content.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional credentials such as CFP®, CIMA®, or CPWA®.
• Background in financial planning topics such as retirement, workplace wealth, tax strategy, or small business planning.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build, shape, and scale new programs or content areas.

Who You Are
You are a forward thinking, client centric leader who brings curiosity, initiative, and a passion for helping financial advisors succeed. You thrive in a collaborative environment and bring a mix of strategic thinking, technical expertise, and exceptional communication skills. You enjoy creating ideas that inspire action and making a measurable impact on advisor growth and client outcomes.

Experience with order entry in at least one of the following security types: Stocks, Exchange Traded Funds, Bonds, Mutual Funds and Options.

Strong attention to detail, highly organized and possesses a strong work ethic.

Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

Strong communication skills.

Experience with order entry for the following security types: Stocks, ETFs, Bonds, Mutual Funds and Options.

Experience with the following systems: APL, BETA, BondDesk, Brokerage Mainframe, SSRS/SharePoint, MS Access.

This role will have excellent visibility working cross functionally with business partners to process client requests, answer trade related inquiries and conduct research of escalated items. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative team environment, while helping you reach your career goals!

Key Responsibilities

Perform daily trading of our Active Portfolio Mutual Funds and/or ETF portfolios traded on-team, as well as the highly complex Drift trading process for internally traded Select Separate Models Only strategies and ETF strategies, and auto-rebalance trading and validation for our SPS Advantage product. This includes trade origination, pre and post trade validation, and reject and exception processing.

Provide support to business partners with trading and maintenance to models, processing client requests, and answering trade-related questions/assisting with research of escalated items.

Build and maintain support relationships with internal WMS and Capital Markets Trading business partners, as well as external money managers and vendors. Collaborative work with third-party money managers regarding model trading and client requests.

Continuous development of on-team systems, tools, and process knowledge.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree.

2+ years of relevant trading/operations experience.

*Post-secondary education and relevant work experience may be interchanged to meet the combined total years of minimum required qualifications for education and experience.

Experience with order entry in at least one of the following security types: Stocks, Exchange Traded Funds, Bonds, Mutual Funds and Options.

Strong attention to detail, highly organized, and possesses a strong work ethic.

Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

Strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with order entry for the following security types: Stocks, ETFs, Bonds, Mutual Funds and Options.

Experience with the following systems: APL, BETA, BondDesk, Brokerage Mainframe, SSRS/SharePoint, MS Access.

Job Description

Where you’ll fit in & what our team goals are…

This is a newly created position within the Global Compliance Monitoring Office ‘GCMO’ team, which is part of the Columbia Threadneedle General Counsel's Office (GCO). You will report into the London-based EMEA Compliance Monitoring Manager, with a dotted reporting line to either the Luxembourg Conducting Officer or the Netherlands Senior Compliance Officer. 

Your role involves performing Compliance monitoring activities covering a variety of regulatory topics and across all business areas (including investment teams, operational functions, sales and marketing, product development, outsourced providers), while also contributing to broader Dutch regulatory compliance expectations. In addition to core monitoring responsibilities, you will act as a key NL-based compliance counterpart, maintaining visibility with regulators (e.g., AFM, DMB), and supporting key supervisory processes such as the Supervisory Review & Evaluation Process (SREP).

How you'll spend your time...

Responsibility for the development, maintenance and execution of the risk-based EU hub, NL, and other European Compliance Monitoring Plans ‘CMP'. Assistance with other European CMPs/monitoring activities will also be expected, including some quarterly travel (e.g., branch office visits and similar).

What you will be doing:

contribute to the design of the NL and other European annual plans (as subsets of the Global CMP)

maintain and enhance regulatory mapping across Dutch, Luxembourg and wider EU regimes 

perform topic based/thematic Compliance monitoring reviews (both regional and as part of wider global reviews)

performance of ongoing/periodic monitoring activities

track, report, and drive timely remediation of issues/ actions arising from monitoring reviews

provide input into compliance reporting for boards and NL risk committee and other relevant committees and forums

lead/participate in due diligence visits and outsourcing oversight reviews of material third party service providers

monitor delegated business activities (internal and external, as appropriate)

provide ad-hoc monitoring support for business change, thematic deep-dives and regulatory queries

support key supervisory processes (e.g., SREP)

support NL Compliance in DORA incident protocols, providing monitoring insight and serving as an independent compliance challenge

assist with ad-hoc Compliance tasks and project work as required

co-ordinate the production of the Systematic Integrity Risk Analysis Reports (SIRA)

collaborate with and provide ad-hoc European regulatory training to other Monitoring team members in the UK, India, and US

To be successful in this role you will have...

Fluent English and Dutch (written & spoken)

Solid, relevant Compliance Monitoring or Internal Audit expertise, ideally within Asset Management

Solid knowledge of MiFID regulations 

Solid knowledge of investment funds structure/operation/regulation (UCITS & AIFs)

Familiarity with European regulatory regimes, primarily De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) and Authoriteir Financiele Markten (AFM)

Team player

Organised, curious and self-motivated, with good analytical skills

Good interpersonal skills

Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

If you also had this, it would be great…

Familiarity with European regulatory regimes (other than Luxembourg/CSSF)

Familiarity with Lux and Ireland fund structures and regulatory regimes

Good understanding of fiduciary business (Netherlands Pension Fund business)

Job Description

Are you ready to apply your analytical expertise on a dynamic, world-class HR team? Ameriprise Financial is seeking a Senior Human Capital Insights (HCI) Analyst to join our high-performing organization. In this role, you’ll help shape talent strategies by delivering actionable people insights that drive meaningful conversations across the enterprise.

As a Senior HCI Analyst, you will:
 - Partner with team members and stakeholders to identify data and analytics needs.
 - Transform complex data into compelling stories for executive audiences.
 - Guide leaders in interpreting results, discussing implications, and enhancing data literacy. 
 - Serve as a trusted authority on HR data and reporting, bringing creativity and innovation to new solutions.

What you bring:
 - Strong analytical and data management skills.
 - Experience creating innovative approaches and solutions.
 - A passion for using insights to influence strategy and elevate decision-making.

How you'll spend your time…

Provide insights and recommendations based on data observations. Independently lead a variety of efforts to ensure HCI is an active participant in various projects. Maintain understanding of all HR management system (HRMS) modules and provide support on any data set as required. Identify and implement standardized processes for reporting and analysis

Use multiple tools and systems to produce reports in response to requests from clients. Consult with requesters to verify business needs and clarify requirements. Identify appropriate data sources, develop and test queries, perform quality verification of data to ensure accuracy, and provide products within agreed time frame.

Identify data issues through analysis and collaboration with key partners. Define data audit procedures and requirements, design audit queries, and perform scheduled audits. Raise all identified data or system issues to the appropriate person(s) for resolution. Research system issues and data trends. Use statistical programming and data visualization software.

Lead incoming requests through intake process and engage with clients to ensure understanding of and alignment with requirements. Analyze requests and delegate work as appropriate. Identify and help implement solutions for enhanced operations, processes, and products to elevate team and business performance and to enable data-driven decisions.

To be successful in this role, you will have...

Bachelor's degree or equivalent and 3 to 5 years of experience in working with data analysis, reporting, or consulting

Post-secondary education and related experience may be interchanged to meet the combined total years of minimum required qualifications for education and experience.

Excellent ability to collaborate, understand requests and communicate results and recommendations.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and experience with organizing and running project plans.

If you also have this, even better...

Education or training focused in HR, Analytics, Math, Finance, Statistics, Industrial/Organizational (I/O) Psychology, Behavioral Sciences or similar

Experience with HR Analytics and HRMS (Workday preferred)

Experience with data manipulation and visualization (e.g., Excel, Power BI)

Experience with statistical programs (e.g., Python, R, SQL)

Job Description

The ServiceNow Architect is responsible for leading the platform’s overall architecture, strategy, and governance ensuring scalability, performance, security, and alignment with enterprise priorities. The role defines the roadmap, establishes development standards, and serves as the technical authority across key modules such as EA, ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, and the ServiceNow AI module, driving adoption and optimization. The architect is also accountable for implementing new modules and capabilities as needed, designing and delivering end‑to‑end solutions, enabling automation, maintaining data integrity, managing integrations and environment strategy, and ensuring code quality, compliance, and CMDB accuracy. Strong hands‑on expertise across modules, deep understanding of ITIL and integration patterns, and advanced ServiceNow certifications are highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the overall ServiceNow platform architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and security.

Own the ServiceNow roadmap and align platform capabilities with business and enterprise architecture priorities.

Define and enforce governance standards, development frameworks, and best‑practice guidelines.

Evaluate new releases, plugins, and features and provide recommendations on adoption and optimization.

Act as the technical lead across key ServiceNow modules, including:

Enterprise Asset Management (EA) – hardware, software, mobile, cloud assets

ITSM – Incident, Problem, Change, Request

ITOM – Discovery, CMDB, Service Mapping

ITAM – HAM/SAM automation

HRSD, SecOps, CSM (as needed)

Optimize asset lifecycle processes, data models, and automation workflows.

Architect and deliver end‑to‑end solutions—including data models, integrations, workflows, and automation.

Perform hands‑on development: Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Catalog Items.

Build custom scoped apps and integrations using REST/SOAP, MID Server, IntegrationHub.

Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and process teams to define requirements and implement scalable solutions.

Oversee instance strategy, configuration management, and environment planning.

Conduct code reviews, enforce security/compliance requirements, and ensure development quality.

Drive CMDB accuracy and maintain strong EA/ITAM data integrity.

Create and maintain reusable architectural templates, patterns, and accelerators.

Deep, hands‑on expertise in the EA module and multiple core modules.

Excellent understanding of ITIL, Asset Management, CMDB, and enterprise integration patterns.

Preferred certifications: CSA, CIS (EA/ITSM/ITOM/ITAM), CAD; CTA is a plus.

Cloud certification (AWS, Azure or GCP)

The Strategic Insight team conducts research across the enterprise, from Advice & Wealth Management to Insurance & Annuities. With 70+ years of combined experience in research, the Strategic Insight team is focused on crafting the right projects to inform key strategic initiatives globally.

Key Responsibilities 

Consulting: Lead tactical and mid‑tier primary research from intake to recommendations, partnering with Marketing, Analytics, CX, and Product to clarify decisions and translate insights into action. Identify and frame trends, risks, and opportunities; work independently and/or alongside team leads. 

Critical Analysis: Perform analysis using Excel, Qualtrics, and Power BI/Tableau. Synthesize quantitative and qualitative inputs, augment with secondary sources or additional primary studies, and deliver concise, decision‑ready findings.

Team Operations & Governance: Maintain project artifacts and shared resources; support initiatives that strengthen governance, team effectiveness, and compliance. 

Required Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (or 4+ years of relevant experience). 

3+ years of primary research and survey experience, including questionnaire design, field management, data quality controls, and interpretation. 

Hands-on experience with survey platforms (e.g., Qualtrics) to build, launch, monitor, and quality check studies. 

Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate cross-functional inputs and meet deadlines and manage end-to-end research projects. 

Proven synthesis and communication skills—translate quantitative and qualitative data into clear, action-oriented insights. 

Stakeholder-ready storytelling and presentation skills, including experience presenting to leaders. 

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel

Preferred Qualifications 

Analytics & visualization tools (Power BI or Tableau); comfortable partnering with analytics teams 

Regulated industry exposure (finance, insurance, healthcare) or familiarity with compliance and privacy considerations 

Customer feedback ecosystems: Exposure to Voice of the Client (VoC) programs or Customer Experience (CX) tracking studies, and ad hoc pulse surveys 

Strategic synthesis: experience connecting insights to business questions, highlight what matters most and propose clear implications 

Vendor management experience, including working with market research partners to execute impactful research 

Relevant academics: coursework in business, marketing, market research, statistics, data analytics, data science, economics, consumer insights, or applied social sciences
